title: What are the different Types of Group Therapy, and Who can Benefit from Them?
h1: Types of Group Therapy: Benefits, Approaches, and Who Can Benefit

featuredImage.alt: psychologist in gurgaon for Group Therapy

excerpt: Types of Group Therapy: Benefits, Approaches, and Who Can Benefit Group therapy brings people together who have similar struggles and are going through the same phase in life. It can help people in rehabilitation and undergoing any similar kind of mental health struggle connect together and share their concerns under the guidance of a trained […]
contentHtml:
Group therapy brings people together who have similar struggles and are going through the same phase in life. It can help people in rehabilitation and undergoing any similar kind of mental health struggle connect together and share their concerns under the guidance of a trained professional like a psychologist in Gurgaon.

Group therapy is now becoming very popular among people who are looking for treatment under the guidance of an expert who can provide them holistic care and an affordable, community base support.

What is Group Therapy and How does it Work?

Group therapy typically works with around 5 to 15 participants, which are facilitated by one or two facilitators who guide the group. The sessions of group therapy run around 60 to 90 minutes and are taken weekly or fortnightly. The members usually share their experiences, give feedback and learn some new coping mechanisms from their fellow group mates. Since it is a type of therapy, confidentiality rules, apply here as well, and nobody can share the details outside the group.

Types of Group Therapy

There are different types of group therapy, where the therapy itself is the core around which the group works and the groups are divided. According to the kind of support you need.

Cognitive Behavioural Therapy Group

This type of group teaches members to spot the challenges in the negative thought patterns and convert them into positive ones. They learn through imitation and understanding each other’s responses. We have structured sessions and worksheets and homework between meetings. This works well for anxiety, depression, and stress.

Psychoeducational Groups

This helps us focus on learning about a condition, how it gets triggered and what we can do to manage it. This covers medication, awareness, prevention and daily coping mechanisms. It is very common to take this kind of therapy for ADHD, bipolar disorder, OCD and anxiety related issues.

Support Group

This type of group therapy offers a safe space for people to share some common experiences with others that can help them gain perspective. It can be peer led as well as guided by a professional like a therapist in Gurgaon. It is commonly suggested for people who are going through grief, chronic illness and caregiving journeys. It is especially a good idea to take it up for addiction recovery.

Skill Development Group

Such groups help people build a specialised practical skill like emotional regulation, distress tolerance, or build assertiveness in their tone. DBT based groups here are the most popular format and it is quite useful for anger management and building social skills.

Interpersonal process groups

It explores how you can relate to other people through real time interactions and the members give you honest feedback on how to change your unhelpful relationship patterns through the communications you share. These types of groups help with the challenging loneliness, low self-esteem, and difficulty in trusting others.

Specialised groups

These types of groups are designed around tackling one kind of concern – that is like trauma, eating disorders or any kind of parenting or couple issues. It is led by professionals who are focused on training, often one of the best psychologist in Gurgaon for a specific issue.

Who can Benefit from Group Therapy?

Here is a list of people who can actually benefit from group therapy in real time-

  • – People who are suffering from anxiety, depression, or are suffering from heavy social anxiety
  • – Somebody going through grief, trauma, or major life changes
  • – People going through addiction recovery programs, and requiring environmental and social support
  • – Working professional professionals who are dealing with burnout and need an outlet to understand what other people going through the same thing think
  • – Parents, caregiver, and teenagers who require peer understanding of thoughts
  • – Anyone who is feeling isolated and wants to feel heard

Benefits to Consider with Group Therapy

There are a lot of benefits to group therapy because you’re connecting in a social setting and you tend to understand different perspectives into the same issue that you are facing. Let’s look at some of them.

  • – It reduces loneliness and shows you that you are not alone in suffering through a similar kind of problem that others are going through
  • – It offers a varies perspective into the same issue and provide you with practical coping mechanism that you can apply in your own life
  • – It is more affordable than one-on-one therapy
  •  It is a specialised for a similar kind of concern so that you can connect and build a sense of belongingness

Choosing the Right Therapist in Gurgaon

There are some ways to connect with the group therapist who can actually provide you the kind of value you are looking for from your therapy. Here are some things to consider.

  • – Check the qualifications, registration, and therapy experience of the particular expert you are going to
  • – Look for a therapist in Gurgaon who specialises in your concern
  • – Reviews and compare findings while searching for the best psychologist in Gurgaon

Group therapy is an accessible and effective route to find healing within a social circle, where you find sense of belongingness and shared perspective. So, if you are looking for a group therapy experience, connecting with an institution like Tulasi Healthcare can help you understand, what are your options and you can book a consultation today with our expert group therapy options.

If you see sleep, changes, irritability, and loss of interest in daily work, constant worry around things and physical symptoms that emulate this, it is good to talk to a therapist or approach and search for a mental therapist near me. The effective treatment here in wall therapy, CBT, and psychiatric support and more severe cases. If you’re looking for the best therapist for depression in Delhi and Gurgaon, look for a proper experience in the particular field, and if they provide a structure, planning and comfort according to your needs.

When Habits Take Over – Recognising OCD

So, if you’re looking for an OCD therapist near me, you can look into ERP trained specialists that work with OCD cases and provide a proper treatment plan.

Therapy that Fits Your Schedule- Online Versus in Person

Since the individuals have a lot of complex concerns regarding how they can meet an expert, or whether they will be able to find time for an in person session or find the right psychotherapist in Delhi or Gurgaon depending upon their region, finding the right model of online versus in person is an option.

Questions to Ask before Booking Your First Session

title: Can Ketamine Therapy Transform Mental Healthcare and What should You Know?
h1: Ketamine Therapy: A New Approach to Mental Health Treatment

featuredImage.alt: psychiatrist in delhi for ketamine therapy

excerpt: Ketamine Therapy: A New Approach to Mental Health Treatment It has been a long time since psychiatric ailments have since started not responding to traditional medicine and antidepressants. People have been facing concerns on how they can get their elements treated while still maintaining lower dependence on medication. This is where ketamine enters the conversation […]
contentHtml:
It has been a long time since psychiatric ailments have since started not responding to traditional medicine and antidepressants. People have been facing concerns on how they can get their elements treated while still maintaining lower dependence on medication. This is where ketamine enters the conversation as a solution.

It was originally an FDA approved anesthetic, and now it has been working as a repurposed, psychiatric medicine in lower and control doses. While some people in the field are still torn on its applicability, we at Tulasi Healthcare discuss it openly as an option while people come to consult with a psychiatrist in Delhi to explore it.

What is Ketamine Therapy?

Ketamine is available in its two clinical forms, – IV ketamine infusion (off label use) and esketamine nasal spray. Since it is a very controlled and minimum use drug, it is administered very discreetly in a clinical and hospital setting only and requires a vital monitoring throughout the whole session.

It is typically administered within some series of sessions and it is definitely not a one-time fix. It often takes over six infusions, which will be considered over 2 to 3 weeks initially.

How does it Work on the Brain?

Ketamine usually takes effect on the glutamate/NMDA receptor system, where it triggers rapid synaptogenesis.
This in general means that it really regrows the neural pathways and connections which were damaged by the chronic stress and depression, not being able to be repaired by the general antidepressants and antipsychotics, which were administered for initial treatment.

This mechanism explains why it is a stand out – because symptom relief is within hours today versus The 4 to 6 week period which is required for standard antidepressants.

Conditions It can Help with

There are different kinds of conditions ketamine therapy can help with. Let’s take a look at some of these.

  • – Treatment resistant Depression: Some of the best psychiatrist in Delhi will consider this approach if they feel that 2+ fail, standard medication have not had any kind of effect on the patient.
  • – Major Depressive Disorder: In case of active suicidal ideation, it is applied in ER in crisis scenarios, where rapid stabilisation is necessary.
  • – PTSD: This therapy is particularly applied in cases where trauma response has not improved with therapy itself and active medications have also not helped.
  • – OCD: There is still limited application for this therapy here, but there is evidence for chronic pain linked depression, and OCD being discovered.

What Makes Ketamine Therapy Different from Traditional Medicines?

  • – Speed: it has a high rate of effectiveness and shows within hours versus weeks. This proves to be critical in many suicide linked cases.
  • – Mechanism: Bypasses the serotonin pathway entirely and is used when SSRIs and SNRIs have failed.
  • – Not meant for long-term use: It is usually used as a bridge therapy alongside predecided therapy and medication.
  • – It requires in clinic administration, unlike take- home oral medications.

Is it Safe? What to Expect?

Usually, it is safe in many specs when given under controlled circumstances.
Some of the things to keep in mind include –

  • – Common short-term effects are: dissociation, elevated blood pressure, nausea, dizziness.
  • – It is not recommended for patients who have a problem of uncontrolled hypertension, history of psychosis or heart conditions.
  • – It cannot be applied as a walk-in option because it requires a pre-psychiatric treatment evaluation.
  • – There is a risk of misuse or dependency if it is applied outside of a clinical setting and that is why reinforcing it with a licensed psychiatrist in Delhi is expected. They should be the ones overseen treatment for a proper application.

Growing Conversation around Ketamine in India

Indian psychiatry is growing around Ketamine and it is increasingly being adopted in Metro cities and hospitals that are having specialised clinics. The awareness around it is rising because of the global coverage around it and there are some regulations that make it remain limited compared to the US.

It is still not positioned as a first choice treatment, but rather a second line of crisis intervention. This is why approaching a best psychiatrist in Delhi with specific training matters when you are going into ketamine assisted protocols.

It is a Promising Tool, but not a Miracle Cure

Ketamine is a tool that has a broader and personalised treatment plan. It is not a miracle worker or a replacement for any kind of therapy. Setting realistic expectations around it as a psychiatrist in Delhi is a matter of concern – because rapidly does not mean permanent cure if any reader is experiencing and going through treatment resistant symptoms, this can be your sign to consult with a psychiatrist in Delhi to asses if they are a candidate to fit ketamine therapy.

h1: What is Substance Abuse Treatment and How Does Recovery Work?

featuredImage.alt: mental hospital in gurgaon for Substance Abuse Treatment

excerpt: What is Substance Abuse Treatment and How Does Recovery Work? Substance abuse can turn a person’s life upside down and puts their relationships in turmoil. It definitely starts with an occasional habit that turns into something that the person cannot control themselves. The urge and the urgency to consume that substance and indulge that habit […]
contentHtml:
Substance abuse can turn a person’s life upside down and puts their relationships in turmoil. It definitely starts with an occasional habit that turns into something that the person cannot control themselves. The urge and the urgency to consume that substance and indulge that habit takes the person away from their responsibilities, families and as well as work life. To prevent this, substance abuse treatment is planned by experts in the mental healthcare sector.

What Exactly is Substance Abuse Treatment?

This is a program that consists of medical, psychological and emotional care. It provides a person the reasons and the help to stop substance safely so that they can rebuild their life in a healthier manner.

Substance abuse treatment is offered at a mental hospital in Gurgaon, which is performed under trained professionals like psychiatrists, addiction specialists, and counselors working together towards the same goal.

Substance abuse treatment just does not work upon the addiction itself, but it also works upon treating the medical condition for the mental health condition that lies underneath it. It takes everything in account and holds the conditions accountable for the behaviour it has produced, like depression or anxiety.

The treatment itself combines detox, therapy and long-term support. It is never a quick fix and it takes its own time with every individual.

Signs You May Require Help

There are some critical signs that may appear like normal behaviour masked as habits, but they are truly some things that you may require help with. Let’s discover a few of them so that you can understand the difference between occasional substance abuse.

Needing More of a Substance Over Time

As you start to consume more alcohol, drugs, or any other substance that you are continuously using – it starts to lose its effect. To make up for the lost effect, people start to consume more and more of the substance and that turns into addiction over time.

Trying to Quit Our Cutback and not Being Able to

Some people understand it midway that they are starting to go more into the effect of the substance they are using and try to cut back. But it so happens that the body is so used to it and their mind is so used to the effect that they are unable to cut back on it. The willingness is there, but the motivation is lacking.

It Starts to Affect Your Life

You may feel that the use of the substance is starting to affect your performance at your job, in your relationship and is having a drastic effect on your finances.

Behavioural Changes

Your family in French express concerns about how your behaviour has changed for the worse since you have started consuming the substance.

These are the signs that are cute to consult a psychiatric Hospital in Gurgaon for a proper evaluation.

The Recovery Process Step-by-Step

The recovery process has a guided list of structured care which we follow at our mental hospital in Gurgaon.

Assessment and Detox

We take a very detailed intake evaluation. Our psychiatrist here try to understand the history that you have with the substance, how your mental health has been affected and the physical condition that you are in. We provide a medically supervised detox that helps you manage the withdrawal symptoms safely. Stopping it abruptly without support can be very dangerous as the withdrawal symptoms can be very harmful. At Tulasi Healthcare, we provide round the clock monitoring to help you phase out of this difficult journey easily.

In patient/Residential care

Since it is a very highly socially prone issue, we suggest individuals to continue the journey in an impatient setting. This provides them a structured routine where therapy, medication and activities are performed to stabilise the person. We have care which is delivered at our psychiatric mental hospital in Gurgaon with 24 x 7 supervision. This distraction free environment helps people stay away from the triggers that indulge them in substance use.

Therapy and Counselling

We provide one on one therapy and counseling for people to understand their personal triggers and build appropriate coping strategies for themselves. We also provide group therapy sessions where people connect with other individuals who are going through the same journey as them. This provides their motivation and experiences to survive and support each other. We use cognitive behavioural approaches to reframe thought patterns and family counselling sessions to repair relationships and educate people about these issues

After Care and Relapse Prevention

During after-care, we provide regular OPD follow-ups and discharge to track progress. This helps you gain access to proper support groups as well and people who are going on the same journey. Help you understand what kind of issues you might face and guidance on lifestyle changes is also provided.

You also gain access to prevention plans which are tailored to your specific issues.

Why Choose a Professional Treatment?

Professional treatment with Tulasi Healthcare can help you gain access to a lot of context, care and standardised treatment plans which are not available if you seek treatment from the comfort of your home.

  • – Get access to trained psychiatrists and addiction specialists rather than relying on just your willpower.
  • – If you’re looking for a mental hospital near me and trying to get treated in your vicinity, we are the best mental hospital in Gurgaon.
  • – We provide you with integrated care that treats addiction and underlying conditions together at our psychiatric mental Hospital in Gurgaon.
  • – We provide you with better long-term outcomes compared to unsupervised attempts to quit.

Recovery is a Gradual Process

Recovery is truly achievable, but it is also required that you get the right Medical and emotional support when there is time. Reaching out to a psychiatric hospital in Gurgaon is a confidential and judgement free, first step, which you will take towards your mental and emotional well-being. Connect with us today through our website or a simple walk in. Our experts will be there to guide you every step of the way.

Anxiety Issues

Anxiety issues feel like you have racing thoughts, trouble sleeping, and panic all over. They can show up as avoiding situations, overthinking our decisions, and being very worrying in even the slightest of issues. We help you find your triggers and help you learn to calm down and help yourself ground in such situations.

It is a feeling of heaviness and emptiness in life, and people tend to generally lose interest in whatever they enjoy the most. It can manifest as withdrawal from social situations and severe appetite changes with loss in sleep. The person starts to feel like a burden to their loved ones, and they start to isolate themselves from the social environment. We help you build a safe space here and talk about your concerns without being overly positive about everything. We help you bring practicality back into your thoughts and work on negative self talk.

It can show up as work burnout, pressure from your relationships and family duties or even manifest as poor sleep. We help you resolve this by making you aware of your triggers, helping you set boundaries and understanding realistic coping mechanisms.

Trauma and PTSD is inflicted by any sudden and big happening in life that leaves a very deep mark in the psyche of the individual. It can manifest as flashbacks, nightmares, feeling constantly being triggered by reminders of the past. You feel like you cannot trust people, avoid places and people, and can have sudden emotional reactions to things. Tulasi Healthcare, we help you gently work at your pace with the help of a counselor, and the entire focus is on this ability to build your sense of control and safety.

OCD

Obsessive compulsive disorder comprises unwanted and repeating thoughts that can render a person unable to function in their daily life. It shows up as checking behaviour, cleaning, counting, and seeking assurance about things that are unnecessary and do not hold any relation to any kind of productivity. At Tulasi Healthcare, we help you understand the OCD cycle and use proven methods like exposure and response prevention to weaken its hold and help you get your life back on track.

Life Transitions

When you’re feeling lost, uncertain and unsettled after a big change – which can show up after a job change, moving cities or marriage, we help you build a sense of that change in process what you have gone through.

Sometimes people in a relationship can feel unheard, distant and resentful towards their partners because of some unsolved issue. We help you understand your patterns in a relationship and make you learn and express needs clearly with set boundaries. As it’s an Indian society, family expectations can also play a major role.

Finding a Mental Health Counsellor Near You in Gurgaon and Delhi?

Not every issue needs to be figured out on your own – there are people and experts around you who can help you gain a sense of belongingness and normality when it comes to exploring your uncertain thoughts. Connect with us at Tulasi Healthcare today and explore your concerns in a safe and judgement free environment.

If you feel that you are burning out with pressure from your environment, work or relationships and feel that you do not have an outlet to discuss those concerns – then you can approach a mental health counsellor, or your vicinity.

Yes. Every process and conversation that happens during counselling is confidential. According to the ethical standard said by the American Psychological Association. We follow every standard and set of rules that is determined for practising counsellors.

Yes. The quality and the level of the care that we provide during sessions does not change at all, even if it is an in person or an online counselling session.

How many sessions will I need with a counselor?

The number of sessions truly depend upon the kind of concern you present and how severe it is in nature. It generally takes anywhere from 8 to 12 sessions and it can even vary to a lesser or a bigger number.

title: How can Family Support Help During Mental Health and Addiction Recovery?
h1: The Role of Family Support in Mental Health and Addiction Recovery

featuredImage.alt: rehabilitation centre near me for addiction recovery

excerpt: The Role of Family Support in Mental Health and Addiction Recovery Recovery is a process that takes a lot of energy and concern from your relationships. It is not something that happens in isolation. When patients receive unparalleled support from their loved ones, they recover better and have lower relapse rates. If you’re at a […]
contentHtml:
Recovery is a process that takes a lot of energy and concern from your relationships. It is not something that happens in isolation. When patients receive unparalleled support from their loved ones, they recover better and have lower relapse rates. If you’re at a rehabilitation centre near me and are pursuing your treatment plan, the treatment part is only half of the equation of recovery here. Family involvement is the other half that is required to help you gain a holistic sense of wellbeing.

Why does Family Involvement Matter in Recovery?

Family is the one part of the treatment plan that remains with the patient even when they are out in the social setting. Clinicians remain for a small part of time and help you through recovery, but your family understands and sees you in a way that a clinician doesn’t. Help you understand how you have done throughout the treatment process and actually help you carry that particular learning out in the social environment.

Issues like addiction and mental illness often take root in the family dynamics and while your family supports you through your problems, they also resolve theirs in some way or the other. While the family heals, they help you gain perspective of what is happening in your life as well. As a top rehab centre near me, we truly support this perspective and make sure that each and every individual receives their family support throughout the treatment plan.

How Families can Support a Loved one in Treatment

There are many ways families can be of help when a person is going through their recovery journey. Let’s look at some of the pointers-

  • – They learn the basics about addiction and mental illness, and that it is not a character flaw. This helps them understand their loved ones better.
  • – They are made to learn that setbacks are normal. Relapses don’t mean that bad days are a measure of failure.
  • – Boundaries are set and support does not mean covering up for the things that they do, and that providing solutions and judgement towards things they do will help them get any better.
  • – Showing up every day in any way possible, is a step ahead in the journey.

Families usually start by searching for a rehabilitation centre near me where they can find family involvement programmes in the therapeutic modalities.

The Role of Family Therapy in Treatment Programmes

Family therapy is not about providing a secondary support to a person in rehabilitation, but also about improving the family dynamics as a whole and understanding how the environment that surrounds them affects them in certain ways.

  • – These are proper structured sessions with a therapist, not casual conversations. Very properly constructed agendas are discussed with the family members to help them aid the recovery of their loved one.
  • – The focus area includes rebuilding trust, focusing on communication skills, identifying patterns which enable the individual to revert back to their original issues.
  • – It prepares both patients and family for a life after they are discharged and into the real social environment. They are made aware of the challenges and the strengths that a person may have which can be used to guide them better.

As experts, we know that a well structured rehab rehabilitation centre in Delhi will include family therapy as a core part of the program and not an add-on.

Supporting Recovery after Treatment Ends

After family therapy, there are certain points which are to be kept in mind by families that can help them support and build this journey towards a positive outcome. These include-

  • – Keeping the home environment trigger free, which is having no substances and reduced stress and a positive environment at home whenever possible is essential.
  • – Encouraging your loved ones to keep continuing therapy that is individual for the patient and sometimes for the family members as well. This helps keep things in the loop and straightened out for everyone to achieve and explore.
  • – Celebrating small milestones can be a great way to achieve and plan a journey ahead.
  • – It is important for you to learn relapse warning signs like mood shifts, withdrawal, and secret endeavours that they might undertake, which need to be dealt with calmness and not anger and panic.

When to Seek Professional Guidance?

Family support is a big help, but it is not a treatment plan that will help you in the long run. If you’re reading this blog, then you have definitely been searching for a rehab centre near me. We truly encourage you to consult with a qualified professional, who will be able to provide you with Medical supervised care and help you understand what you are going through in the first place.

title: Why is Psychiatric Medication Important in Mental Healthcare?
h1: What Role does Psychiatric Medication Play in Mental Healthcare?

featuredImage.alt: psychiatrist in Delhi for medication management

excerpt: What Role does Psychiatric Medication Play in Mental Healthcare? Mental health concerns today have become a part of a general conversation. In spite of normalising the conversation around it, people try to avoid the stigma and the judgement that comes along with it and try to delay care that comes with it. Medication management in […]
contentHtml:
Mental health concerns today have become a part of a general conversation. In spite of normalising the conversation around it, people try to avoid the stigma and the judgement that comes along with it and try to delay care that comes with it. Medication management in psychiatric care is a medical treatment and not a last resort. Even when you are approaching a mental Healthcare professional, like a psychiatrist in Delhi for your concerns, you will first be analysed according to your issue and the severity of your issues to understand if even medication management is right for you. It can, or it cannot become a part of your recovery, depending upon what kind of issues you’re facing.

How Psychiatric Medication Helps

Issues like depression, anxiety, bipolar, schizophrenia, involve the essence of brain chemistry, and stress response systems which need to be tackled with medication management. Medication targets these issues directly, much like any other physical treatment like diabetes or hypertension. It works on stabilising the systems properly, so that therapy can work on it, and it prevents any kind of relapse or hospitalisation due to its severe complications. When people with severe levels of issues have medication intake, they can restore their sleep and focus and work on their daily functioning.

Why Consult a Psychiatrist in Delhi for Medication?

When it comes to medication management, any other mental health professional cannot prescribe medications other than a psychiatrist. They can diagnose, prescribe and adjust doses according to your need, and they take your age, health, history, and other medicines into consideration before prescribing anything.

Having regular follow-ups with your psychiatrist keeps the treatment on track and safe and effective for future considerations. In a conversation with the best psychiatrist in Delhi, we came to know that people also self medicate sometimes and stopping abruptly risks withdrawal and relapse. So, it is better to be in the guidance of a psychiatrist and it definitely works best alongside therapy and lifestyle support.

When Should You Seek Help?

If you feel you are-

  • – Consistently feeling low moods
  • – Having sleep or appetite changes
  • – Going through panic attack attacks or feeling socially withdrawn
  • – Having trouble in work, school or home environment

Are some common yet very sure signs that you should look into consulting with a psychiatrist. When these issues become very severe, they cannot be controlled just with therapy and counselling alone.

Common Myths Around Psychiatric Medication

Some common maths that usually run around psychiatric medications are-

  • – They are addictive: they are mostly not, and the doctors monitor their use.
  • – If I start once, I will be on them forever: the duration totally depends on the condition and every medication is reviewed regularly.
  • – They will change me from inside and affect my personality: they work on easing symptoms, not who you are.
  • – Taking medication for mental health concerns is wrong and I will be judged for it:  any mental health concern is similar and on par with any physical health concern that you are facing. So ingesting medication is to ease. Your symptoms are nothing to be judged for.

Understanding that medication is safe and effective. Part of care is very essential when you are professionally guided. If you’re looking to understand how medication management can help you in your mental health journey, connect with a psychiatrist near me today at Tulasi Healthcare.

title: Why do People Use Psychological Terms without Understanding their Meaning?
h1: Understanding Psychological Terms: What They Really Mean and Why They Matter
excerpt: Understanding Psychological Terms: What They Really Mean and Why They Matter My mother is a narcissist. I’m so OCD about my desk. That gave me trauma. You read these three sentences. You saw three words. Narcissist, OCD, trauma. All these words have real life implications that can make a person question their own reality. But […]
contentHtml:
My mother is a narcissist.

I’m so OCD about my desk.

That gave me trauma.

You read these three sentences. You saw three words. Narcissist, OCD, trauma. All these words have real life implications that can make a person question their own reality. But when these words show up in common conversations, just like the ones we read above, they lose their meaning, and the clinical weight that they carry.

Social media today completely has changed mental health in many ways. It compresses ideas for us and bite-size, relatable content that loses its plot somewhere on the other.

Psychology terms give people a language for feelings that they never had words for, and that is actually valuable for many of us. But it also has one big implication – it has brought upon a self diagnosis culture that makes people sit with uncertainty without consulting with an expert. If you live in a big city like Gurgaon, consulting with a psychologist in Gurgaon can help you gain perspective on this.

The Cost of Misusing these Words

Although people have gained a lot of understanding around mental health with the advent of normalisation of these terms, it’s somewhere on the other trivialise when somebody is diagnosed with a real condition. Imagine somebody saying that I am a little OCD about this – and somebody on the other hand actually going through obsessive compulsive disorder that has totally disrupted their daily life.

If you get in a conversation with any therapist in Gurgaon, he will get to know that it makes it very difficult for people with real conditions to be taken seriously, when terms like these are normalised and used without context. Sometimes people are also thrown into a thought process where they think that their normal behaviour is also a pathology to be discussed with an expert.

Sometimes, it becomes a task for a therapist also when people approach them with these questions. They have to make the clients learn the implications that generalisation carries for it.

Commonly Misused Terms

During our conversation with some of the best psychologist in Gurgaon, we identified some terms that people commonly misuse.

  • – Gaslighting versus simple disagreement
  • – Narcissist versus somebody who is just self centred
  • – Trauma versus a bad day
  • – Triggers versus mild annoyance
  • – Anxiety as a personality trait rather than a clinical condition

Why Getting it Right is Important

With the right meaning behind a word, people actually see the right kind of help and do not downplay their concerns. This actually reduces stigma by keeping real conditions distinct and their effect respectable on a person’s life. Taking care of such concerns encourages people to consult a professional like a psychologist near me properly instead of self labelling themselves.

When should You actually See Someone?

If you feel that you are consistently low, having disrupted sleep, appetite and inability to function on a daily basis – it is your sign to go towards professional evaluation rather than looking into an internet diagnosis. Consulting with a professional like a therapist near me today can help you sort your thoughts in a simple and guided way.

It’s great to be aware about mental health concerns that live in and around you – but self diagnosing through social media is something that we should be warding off to preserve the dignity of people actually suffering from these concerns.

title: Why is Mental Health Recovery Often Misunderstood?
h1: Mental Health Recovery: What You Need to Know
excerpt: Mental Health Recovery: What You Need to Know Sometimes, people mistake mental health recovery as a process of being “completely fine”. But in reality, this is not the case at all. Recovery truly looks different for every person, and it can include setbacks, approaches, growth and learning coping skills all while their graph of learning […]
contentHtml:
Sometimes, people mistake mental health recovery as a process of being “completely fine”. But in reality, this is not the case at all. Recovery truly looks different for every person, and it can include setbacks, approaches, growth and learning coping skills all while their graph of learning goes up and down.

While going through mental health recovery, we cannot expect anyone to be completely fine as soon as they undergo therapy and step out into the world. It is a very continuous and ongoing process. As a rehab Centre in Gurgaon, we truly understand this expectations of people from treatment, whether it be physical or mental in nature.

Recovery is not Overnight

Mental health conditions take their own time to manage and understand. Every single person takes their own time to wrap their head around what is happening to them, build acceptance around it, and then work towards their recovery.

Medication management, therapy, meditative measures, and family approaches – all play a critical role while understanding what mental health recovery means.

It is true that therapy combines a lot of different measures, but not every therapy holds true for everyone. Every single person has their own unique needs and goals within therapy and recovery tends to focus on that.

Is Recovery Absence of Symptoms?

If you approach an expert at a rehabilitation centre in Gurgaon, just having a simple conversation will make you understand the fact that recovery is not the absence of symptoms. The symptoms linger around for a long time, they are just turned down because of the treatment.

A person may still experience stress, anxiety, low mood, cravings, or difficult days while making meaningful progress.

As responsible people around them, it is our imperative to focus on things like emotional recovery, improved functioning and self awareness so that they can adjust back into the society and work like a functioning member of the society.

Why Rehabilitation is Important.

Rehabilitation builds a number of habits and insights into a person that is required for returning them back into the society for a perfect functioning. If you approach and look into any rehabilitation centre near me, you will find certain practices that will truly help you understand why rehabilitation is important during mental health recovery.

Rehabilitation includes counselling, therapy, psychiatric care, skill-building, family involvement, and relapse-prevention support, depending on the person’s needs.

As the person approaches rehabilitation, they understand its criticality in their lives and try to imbibe it into their daily routine. It not only helps on a physical and mental level – but it truly helps a person gain perspective on what their past was and what their future will be.

When should Someone Consider a Rehabilitation Centre Gurgaon?

When a person feels that their life in general – that is work, safety, relationships, and personal understanding are suffering, this is when they should approach your rehab Centre in Gurgaon.

When things get a lot out of hand, and a person cannot function in their daily life without external support, they can consider a rehab centre where they will be provided with structured and ongoing support to understand what their perspective currently is and how they should develop it through proper goal setting.

The Right Way to Measure Mental Health Recovery

Recovery should not be totally about attaining “perfection”- but actual “progress”.

The goal is not simply to “look normal,” but to help a person regain stability, confidence, functioning, and quality of life.

title: What is psychosis, what causes it and what treatment options are available?
h1: Psychosis: Symptoms, Causes, Diagnosis and Treatment
excerpt: Psychosis: Symptoms, Causes, Diagnosis and Treatment Psychosis is a term that is used loosely by many people without any particular constraint or concerns regarding its serious issues with mental health problems. It is a break from reality where the person gets lost between the line of illusion and reality. It is not a diagnosis itself […]
contentHtml:
Psychosis is a term that is used loosely by many people without any particular constraint or concerns regarding its serious issues with mental health problems. It is a break from reality where the person gets lost between the line of illusion and reality. It is not a diagnosis itself – but a symptom of a bigger concern that hides behind it.

Accompanied by hallucinations, delusions, and disorganised thinking and speech – it renders a person unable to understand what is going on around them. They lose the ability to actually explain what is the thought process around things, and they surrender them to be isolated from their loved ones.

But the stigma around it sometimes renders it as being crazy – which is not true according to the medical standards of measurement. It can be temporary or tuned down just because it is a rendition of another condition.

Signs and Symptoms to Look Out for

There are some common signs and symptoms that can indicate psychosis easily. It is just about understanding how you can spot it properly.

  • – Seeing and hearing things that are not present
  • – Withdrawing from people, talking about unrelated things and having confused speech
  • – Changes in sleep and self-care is diminished
  • – Having strong unshakeable beliefs about things that are not true
  • – Disorganised, thinking and behaviour
  • – Lack of motivation and reduced emotion in life and losing interest in normal daily activities

The best and foremost sign that you can understand is to know and see that they are interacting with things that are not present in real life. If you’re confused about how to approach this behaviour, you can connect with a psychiatrist in Delhi and understand the concerns and symptoms more effectively.

Causes Behind Psychosis

With a mix of environmental, genetic and situational concerns, there are lots of causes that can manifest psychosis as a condition. Let’s understand what these are with a small brief conceptualisation.

  • – You might be suffering from mental health conditions, like schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, or severe depression, which resulted in manifestation of psychosis.
  • – You might be involved in substance use and withdrawal
  • – You might come out through a medical condition like brain injury, tumours, infections, or autoimmune problems that have a high chance of manifesting psychosis as a symptom
  • – You might suffer from extreme stress, trauma, or sleep deprivation
  • – You might have a genetic predisposition or family history regarding psychosis

So these conditions clearly define how you can manifest psychosis and understanding the true cause and concerns behind it can be done better by an expert like a psychosis treatment in Delhi at Tulasi Healthcare.

Treatment Options Available for Psychosis

With the advancement in understanding how psychosis manifests and works, the Medical fraternity has come up with many treatment options that reduce and eliminate psychosis, according to the symptoms at shows. Let’s look at some of them.

Anti Psychotic Medication

Anti-psychotic medication works by changing how your brain uses chemical messengers like dopamine, serotonin to reduce the symptoms of psychosis like hallucination and delusion.

Psychotherapy/CBT

The best and widely researched method of therapy for this condition is Cognitive Behavioral Therapy psychosis (CBTp.) This therapy collaboratively walks with individuals to manage the impact of their experiences. It reduces symptoms, distress, and develops a coping mechanism to explore figurative truths behind their manifestations. It improves the motivation and understanding of reality behind psychosis.

Family Support and Psycho Education

It is very important for individuals to receive the support of their loved ones. When they are going through a situation that affects their mental health. We provide proper psycho education and family therapy support to the family as a whole unit for the individuals to feel motivated and understood during this time of need.

Hospitalisation for Severe Episodes

Psychosis may sometimes manifest acute episodes that may be violent or out of control for people to handle. For this, our emergency services are always open so that experts can step in and truly help your loved ones deal with this condition in a proper and structured manner.

With these proper insights and treatment plans, our team of best Psychiatrist in Delhi steps in with reinforcements to help you every step of the way. You can build a proper and insightful treatment plan for your loved ones through our expertise and comfort and understanding of your concerns.

When Should You Seek Help for Psychosis?

It is normal to seek help when you feel that you are not in the right state of mind. It is not a concern of fear, shame, or problems that may arise from the stigma surrounding psychosis– it is about you and your health being affected by things that are not in your control. With Tulasi Healthcare, we help you understand what is going on every step of the way and step to help you in any capacity that we can connect with our team today and understand how we support you every step of the way.

If you are looking for an expert who can actually help you with these concerns that are out of your own understanding – approaching a therapist in Delhi might be a great idea for you to explore. This kind of pattern definitely needs a professional, unpacking and understanding.

title: Psychodynamic Therapy: What It Is and How It Works
h1: Psychodynamic Therapy: Understanding the Approach

featuredImage.alt: psychodynamic therapy: what it is and how it works

excerpt: Psychodynamic Therapy: Understanding the Approach Ever notice how some arguments you have, repeat the same pattern with the same people in your life? Or how some small comment at work and review, drained and upset for many days? That is usually not about the thing itself – but it is about something deep inside you, […]
contentHtml:
Ever notice how some arguments you have, repeat the same pattern with the same people in your life? Or how some small comment at work and review, drained and upset for many days? That is usually not about the thing itself – but it is about something deep inside you, running quietly in the background. This is exactly what psychodynamic therapy in Gurgaon helps you explore and resolve.

What is Psychodynamic Therapy Exactly?

It is a form of talk therapy that allows people to look at their past – especially their childhood and the experiences they had with their early relationships and understand how it has shaped them in their present and how it will affect their future. Instead of just managing the symptoms, it tries to get at the root of the problem. For example, if you struggle with trust and find it difficult to place your trust in people, a psychodynamic therapist won’t just help you understand how to trust more, but they will actually help you know what difficulty has resulted in this particular trait in the first place and why it keeps showing up.

How is it Different from Other Therapies?

Many therapy styles are focused on the present, and what are the symptoms that plague the clients currently. But psychodynamic therapy focuses more on the patterns that were learnt early on in life, and why they are still running your life without you realising it. It is less about quick fixes, but more about building a lasting inside from the experiences that have built your early days.

What Happens in a Session?

If you’re looking for psychodynamic therapy sessions in Gurgaon, you can exactly expect conversational sessions, but not very clinical in nature. Your therapist listens very closely, not just about what you have to say, but also about what you avoid, what keeps repeating and what has been happening over time, and if you notice a pattern. Over time, this builds a clearer picture of your inner insight, and things that once felt confusing, start making sense.

There is no pressure to perform or arrive with a fixed agenda. You only talk and understanding builds session by session.

Finding a Psychodynamic Therapist in Gurgaon

A good psychodynamic therapist in Gurgaon will always create a space for you where you don’t feel judged or rush to answer for things that you are concerned about. You should look for someone who is stained specifically for this approach. It takes patience, depth, and not a checklist of techniques. title: ACT Therapy- A Simple Guide to Acceptance and Commitment Therapy
h1: What is ACT therapy?
excerpt: Many times, you must have heard phrases like – just stop worrying, don’t think about it or just stay positive. This does sound familiar to you right? We have all heard this advice in some way or the other. Your brain does not switch off worry, just because someone tells you too. In fact, the […]
contentHtml:
Many times, you must have heard phrases like – just stop worrying, don’t think about it or just stay positive. This does sound familiar to you right? We have all heard this advice in some way or the other. Your brain does not switch off worry, just because someone tells you too. In fact, the more you try to force a thought away, the more it tends to come back around.

So what does actually help? It is not fighting your mind, but it is working with it. That is the whole idea behind ACT therapy. It is a therapy style that is built for a real life, not a perfect one. You still shop for work, family, and friends that you care about even when your days are not as perfect as you want them to be. Let’s understand about A therapy and how it helps you work on your issues in a simple manner.

ACT stands for acceptance & commitment therapy. It is a modern evidence based approach that taps into mental health by not trying to erase the painful thoughts, but actually teaching the person to make peace with them. You learn to notice your thoughts in a way without getting stuck in them. Then you are allowed to focus your energy on what truly matters to you. This therapy teaches you focus and acceptance in detail. Let’s look into the course skills that are required to understand ACT therapy well.

Six Core Skills of ACT Therapy

ACT is built around six simple ideas. Together, help you live with more freedom and understand your struggles well.

Acceptance

Here, you stop fighting your feelings. You understand them, and you let them be without any judgement.

Cognitive Delusion

You learn to understand and see your thoughts just as they are not facts or not any command from your mind.

Being Present

You understand to stay in your present and focus on the hair and now, instead of lingering on the past and worrying about what is to be in the future.

Self as Context

You learn that you are not just your thoughts and feelings, but still more than that. You are an observer and not the result of them.

Values Clarification

You get clear on what really matters to you. You understand your family, your work, your health, your growth, and learn to focus on them wholeheartedly.

Committed Action

You take small study steps towards your life and your values, even when it is uncomfortable for you.

Who can Benefit from ACT Therapy

ACT works quite well for different kinds of struggles and mental health issues. Here are a few listed issues that can benefit from the therapy-

Anxiety Disorders and Related Problems

This therapy helps you in stopping to avoid your anxious thoughts and actually involving them to understand if they are facts or unnecessary insights. You learn to move forward with the help of ACT therapy.

Depression

Depression can make life feel unworthy and you feel disconnected from anything that is meaningful. ACT helps you reconnect and understand your values in the small joys of life. Over time, this therapy rebuilds the sense of purpose in life.

Chronic Pain & Stress Related Illness

Living with ongoing pain can shrink your mobility and functionality to a great extent. ACT, teach you to manage your pain without letting it affect your life and every decision that comes with it. You learn to keep doing what matters, alongside the discomfort.

OCD and Related Disorders

Intrusive thoughts and compulsions often feel very impossible to control for people who are suffering from OCD. ACT here does not try to erase these thoughts, but it changes your relationship with them. It loses the grip and reduces the urge for you to act on them very seriously.

Substance Use and Co-occurring Disorders

Old habits like substance abuse often reflect a deep pain in life. ACT helps you build a healthy, value based coping tool instead. It helps you support your recovery when anxiety and depression exist alongside your addiction.

Adult Facing Life Transition

Big changes like job loss, breakups, or grief can push you into despair and leave you feeling stuck. ACT gives you a way to process these problems without getting overwhelmed with them. It helps you take study steps forward, even when the path is unclear.

If you have been searching for psychologist in Delhi for ACT  therapy recently, it would help you to know that these are exact situations that the approach is perfect for.

How ACT Therapy works at Tulasi Healthcare

Our ACT therapy is structured in a very calm and judgement free manner. Our therapist starts by understanding your story, guiding you in a way through the six core skills step-by-step. Every session is personalised for you and nothing feels rushed or generic. Our experts tend to understand your concerns first and then plan a therapy session for you that is tailored for you. If you are exploring ACT therapy in Gurgaon, this kind of thoughtful, one and one care can be expected at Tulasi Healthcare.

What Techniques are used in ACT Therapy

There are certain techniques that are used in ACT therapy to understand and guide individuals to tackle their emotions in a real life space. These are as follows-

Mindfulness Exercises

These are some simple practices that help you stay grounded in the present moment. They make it easier to notice your thoughts without you, getting involved in them.

Guided Imagery

These are visualisation exercises that help you create a distance from your painful thoughts. It makes emotions feel manageable, and you can deal with them without them being overwhelming.

Value Based Worksheets

These are structured exercises that help you identify what matters to you. When you have big ideas of a clear and better life, you can turn them into a personal and clear direction.

Metaphor & Storytelling

Therapists use relatable metaphors to explain and relay tricky, psychological concepts. This makes ideas like diffusion and acceptance so much easier to understand.

Role-play Practice

You practice real life scenarios in a safe space before you go and face them outside. This builds confidence to apply new skills when it comes to

What to Expect during ACT Therapy?

Your first session is usually focused on knowing your goals and challenges. From there, sessions build gradually upon your goals and improvements. You will practise new skills each week and homework is also provided. But this will be light and meaningful- with small practices to try each week. Progress is steady, not instant and that is by design. Many people looking for ACT counselling in Gurgaon want a plan that fits their real life and is not just about theory. This is exactly how our sessions are structured at Tulasi Healthcare.

Is ACT therapy effective?

Yes. Research shows that it works well for anxiety, depression, chronic pain, and more. It does not promise a life free of hard emotions, but tends to give you a rich meaningful life alongside them. This shift and itself brings a lasting relief for many people.

Why Choose Tulasi Healthcare for ACT Therapy?

Our team blends expertise from clinical structures with genuine care. We help you create a safe space where you are heard and not judged for what you are going through. Whether you are new to therapy or have tried approaches before, our experts meet you where you are. If you’re considering ACT treatment in Gurgaon, we are here to guide you through every step. Ready to start your journey? Reach out to Tulasi Healthcare today and book your first ACT therapy session with us.

title: What is DBT Therapy?
h1: What is DBT Therapy?
excerpt: Dialectal behaviour therapy, DBT is a structured form of therapy which is conducted in a conversational manner that helps people manage their emotions and reduce harmful behaviours. It was firstly developed for people who could not handle their emotions and were lacking healthy ways of dealing with them. The dialectical simply means balancing two things […]
contentHtml:
Dialectal behaviour therapy, DBT is a structured form of therapy which is conducted in a conversational manner that helps people manage their emotions and reduce harmful behaviours. It was firstly developed for people who could not handle their emotions and were lacking healthy ways of dealing with them. The dialectical simply means balancing two things at once. It means that you accept yourself as you are while you’re working towards change. This combination is what makes DBT so effective. If you have been searching for DBT therapy, DBT therapy in Gurgaon, or DBT therapy near me, it is first worth understanding. What treatment actually involves. Let’s look at some basic ideas of DBT therapy and how it can help you understand it for your own purposes and issues.

What are the Core Skills of DBT Therapy?

There are some core ideas that guide DBT therapy and help people understand and manage their emotions effectively. Let’s discuss some of them in brief.

Mindfulness Skills

It is learning to stay present in the moment without getting swept in the past or future worries. It is a foundation that other skills are built on.

Distress Tolerance Skills

Our team helps you with proper tools and methods so that you can use them in the hour of crisis and helps you know how you can deal with them with practice sessions within the therapy itself.

Emotional Regulation Skills

This skill makes you understand your emotions thoroughly in depth and makes you question why that emotion occurs in the first place. It tells you how you can gauge it and what can help you manage it effectively.

Interpersonal Effectiveness Skills

While communicating, having the clarity and the boundaries to help with managing, it can be a big step in managing your emotions in turn. So this still helps in drawing social boundaries that protect your emotional well-being.

Who can Benefit from DBT Therapy?

DBT therapy can help individuals with a number of issues. It can specially help people who are facing difficulty with personality disorders and emotional dysregulation. Let’s take a look at the specific issues it can help with.

Borderline Personality Disorder

It was originally created for BPD and it still remains one of the specifically effective and well researched treatments for it.

Self Harm and Suicidal Ideas

DBT helps with concrete tools to manage crises safely, and people can reach out before things escalate to more serious concerns.

Emotional Regulation and Mood Disorders

It helps with anyone who feels and is affected by their emotions, very intensely and swings between its extremes.

Substance Used in Co-occurring Disorders

This address is emotional triggers that often come with addiction, helping people build healthier coping mechanisms.

Adolescent & Women

It is helpful for major life transitions like hormone shifts and added social and family pressures.

How DBT Therapy Works at Tulasi Healthcare

If you’re looking for DBT therapy in Gurgaon or DBT counselling in Gurgaon, Tulasi Healthcare is one of the best in the field. We deliver DBT through a thoughtful mix of one and one therapy sessions and group skills training. It is guided by experienced clinicians who work on a treatment plan with tailored needs. We understand each person’s specific troubles and we help to track their progress through standard measures. For those who prefer flexibility, a therapist near me is also available so location and scheduling is not a barrier.

What Techniques are used in DBT Therapy?

DBT is not just talking about problems, but it is also about practising real skills to deal with them. Therapist using a mix of hands-on techniques that helped clients build the skills and carry them into everyday life. Here’s what It looks like –

Role Playing

Practising real life scenarios in sessions to build confidence and face them before going outside of therapy.

Diary Cards

Tracking emotions, urges, and behaviours in day-to-day life to spot their patterns.

Phone Coaching

Getting real-time therapist support during actual crisis moments and not just scheduled sessions.

Guided Skills Practice

Working on coping techniques and sessions so that they become second nature in everyday life.

What to Expect During Your DBT Therapy?

Expect a mix of individual therapy and group skills. These are usually held weekly and you learn new skills alongside others facing similar problems. In individual sessions, you will work with your therapist to apply these skills to your own situations and concerns. Progress definitely takes time and it isn’t always a straight line, but most people start noticing small shifts within the first few weeks of practice.

Is DBT Therapy Effective?

Yes, DBT is quite effective. It is definitely researched back by decades and remains one of the most affected treatments available for dysregulation of emotions, self harm and BPD. It is shown by studies to consistently reduce hospitalisation and results and few crisis episodes.

Why Choose Tulasi Healthcare for DBT Therapy?

Tulasi Healthcare offers a compassionate & judgement free space. We understand that continuous ongoing support helps you adapt as you grow and this is the core idea of the clinician trained specifically in DBT therapy for children.

So whether you are looking for DBT therapy near me or specifically for DBT counselling in Gurgaon, you don’t have to go on and do everything yourself, our team provides you the right support at the right time and can make all the difference in how your story feels. Reach out to Tulasi Healthcare today and schedule a consultation and start your DBT treatment journey.

h1: What should You Know About Schizophrenia?
excerpt: What should You Know About Schizophrenia? Which schizophrenia can be quite confusing because of the nature of this mental health condition. People can feel frightened, overwhelmed because of the kind of hallucination and struggle that comes with it. Every day task become very issues of their struggle and maintaining relationships and even falling, a conversation […]
contentHtml:
Which schizophrenia can be quite confusing because of the nature of this mental health condition. People can feel frightened, overwhelmed because of the kind of hallucination and struggle that comes with it. Every day task become very issues of their struggle and maintaining relationships and even falling, a conversation can become a big task for them. Many of them even experience fair, isolation in frustration because of the experience that this particular mental health condition produces and they feel different, but they can never explain how. However, schizophrenia is very treatable. If you receive the right diagnosis, medication and therapy, support from a clinical psychologist in Delhi is a must. Many people can manage their symptoms effectively if they consider going to an expert and finding the right treatment for themselves.

Recognising the early science of schizophrenia and seeking help from a psychologist in Delhi is as helpful as early diagnosis. You can achieve great outcomes and possibly manage symptoms to the extent that you get to live a normal life as well.

What are the Symptoms that Define Schizophrenia?

In general it develops very gradually, and people cannot find out what to actually define and look for. The symptoms can also appear suddenly, but there are always small signs to look out for. Common symptoms include.

  • – Hallucinating voices
  • – Believing in things that are not true – delusions
  • – Seen things that are not there
  • – Very disorganised, thinking and confused decision making
  • – Difficulty, speaking properly and staying with a clear thought train
  • – Lack of motivation to perform any task
  • – Social withdrawal
  • – Reduced emotional expression with peers and loved ones
  • – Poor personal hygiene
  • – Difficulty remembering any kind of information

Early signs of schizophrenia usually include little changes in sleep, declining performance, suspiciousness regarding any small thing, loss of interest in loved activities and expressing emotions. These are the signs that definitely should not be ignored and be looked into as soon as possible for better outcomes.

What are the Causes behind Schizophrenia Development?

Didn’t know one single definitive cause that is known to cause schizophrenia . Experts usually believe that several factors walk together to increase the risk of development.

The factors include:-

  • – Any previous family, history of schizophrenia or mental illness
  • – Changes in great chemistry due to changing levels of dopamine and other neurotransmitters
  • – Differences in brain development and structures
  • – High-level of stress
  • – Substance misuse, especially cannabis certain recreational drugs

Having one or more risk factors does not mean that a person will sincerely develop it. There are many environmental triggers which are also responsible. A proper assessment by a clinical psychologist in Delhi and psychiatrist is important when it comes to accurate diagnosis.

What are the Proper Diagnostic Requirements for Schizophrenia?

There is no single blood test or any kind of brain scan that will let you know that this person is going through with schizophrenia. Diagnosis purely based on any detailed medical assessment that is provided to the individual.

A psychiatrist of clinical psychologist in Delhi will evaluate through the following methods-

  • – The person’s symptoms and how long they have been present for understanding if it is an early diagnosis
  • – Medical and family history
  • – Behaviour, thoughts, and emotions that had given point of time along with certain markers
  • – Daily functioning at home, work, school
  • – Whether any Medical conditional pre-that would trigger schizophrenia causing symptoms
  • – Psychometric and clinical assessments

In most cases, specialists recommend physical examinations and lab tests to rule out any mental health conditions. If you’re searching for a psychologist near me after reading this, it is essential that you choose a mental health professional who has experience in assessing and treating mental health conditions properly.

Treatment Options Available for Schizophrenia

Schizophrenia can be managed successfully if the right treatment plan is provided at the right time. Treatment combines many modalities with medication, therapy and family support. In these cases, early intervention is considered as a boon because it provides a safe space for intervention while the individual is quite understanding of their condition. But the proper treatment and diagnosis include –

  • – Antipsychotic medication, which reduce hallucinations and delusions
  • – Psychotherapy for the individual to improve coping mechanisms and build lifelong skills
  • – Cognitive behavioural therapy to address any thoughts that are negative in nature and building a coping mechanism towards it by transforming them into positive thoughts
  • – Family therapy to educate and support the caregiver
  • – Social skills, training, and occupational training to rehabilitate the individual to their individual life
  • – Vocational support to help individuals return to work and their education whenever possible

The treatment plans provided are fully personalised in a way that an individual feels they are made for them and mould according to their needs. At Tulasi Healthcare, we make sure that an individual receives the right kind of care and support according to their needs and expectations.

Expert Advice from Doctors

Seeking professional help can be the right way to understand your condition and find a right treatment plan for it. If you delay treatment in any way, it will allow the symptoms to become more severe and interfere with your daily life and relationship.

It is imperative that you do not ignore any warning signs like hearing voices, any unusual beliefs you are developing or any extreme social with all that you feel is unlike yourself. Talk to a loved one and make them understand, and this is not normal for you. These experiences required Medical attention at the earliest. Remember medical conditions, not a weakness that you need to explore and work upon on your own. With consistent care, many people go on to achieve proper stability in life.

Consider our Professional Support from Tulasi Healthcare

If you or someone you love is experiencing the early signs of schizophrenia, it is essential that you consult a qualified psychologist in Delhi today. These small symptoms can be a sign towards your healthy being in the long run, if paid attention to properly. At Tulasi Healthcare, our imperative is to provide the best care possible and with the best care plan according to your needs and diagnosis.

Our team provides comprehensive assessment, therapy, counselling for schizophrenia in Delhi and ongoing support for individuals and families to help them get back on their feet. With the right care and compassion, it is our moral imperative to help build the right intervention that can make a lasting difference in your recovery.

h1: Can a Psychologist Diagnose Bipolar Disorder?

featuredImage.alt: psychologist in delhi for bipolar disorder

excerpt: Can a Psychologist Diagnose Bipolar Disorder? A psychologist can easily assess and identify in case your loved one is suffering from bipolar disorder very easily. There are a series of test and exams that can be done to identify the signs and symptoms. A psychiatrist can work on this and confirm the medical issues and […]
contentHtml:
A psychologist can easily assess and identify in case your loved one is suffering from bipolar disorder very easily. There are a series of test and exams that can be done to identify the signs and symptoms. A psychiatrist can work on this and confirm the medical issues and prescribe any medication if required. A psychologist in Delhi can work on this and help people know the assessment process and what can be the right way to begin treatment.

What Symptoms can be seen in Bipolar Disorder?

There will be many changes in the mood and activity levels of a person who is going through with bipolar disorder. These changes are not normal. And they are very easily spottable if you pay close attention. They can deter you from your work, relationships and daily life.

Some common symptoms that can be seen in this include –

  • – Feeling energetic, or confident and hopeful for many days at a stretch
  • – Talking very fast and being very full of ideas and jumping from one idea to another
  • – Sleeping from little to nothing and having a lot of energy without feeling tired
  • – Making risky decisions without any preplanning
  • – Feeling sad and hopeless and empty for long period of time
  • – Feeling that you are losing interest in your hobbies, and the things you love
  • – Finding it hard to concentrate on things
  • – Experiencing changes in appetite and sleeping habits
  • – Suicidal thoughts and feelings of isolation

If you notice these things, it will be very beneficial for you if you consider going to a psychologist consultation in Delhi.

What are the Causes that Make up for Bipolar Disorder?

No single factor in itself causes bipolar disorder. There are many factors like biology, psychology, and environmental factors that increase the risk of developing it. Genes play a very important role here. People who have family history are at a higher risk of developing the condition. However, many people who do not even have a family history can also develop it.

Brain chemistry also plays a very vital role. It as it affects more regulation, changes in brain chemicals can influence the emotions. It in fact changes your energy levels and behaviour.

Environmental factors like stressful life, events, emotional issues and major losses can trigger episodes. Poor sleep and substance use can also add to the high risk of developing polar disorder. During the assessment, a psychologist studies these factors very deeply.

What is the Process of Diagnosis of Bipolar Disorder by a Psychologist?

Structured assessment tools are used by a psychologist to understand the mood changes and emotion experiences that a person goes through. They make sure that the daily functioning and Medical history are all logged. They also use standard psychological tests and questionnaires to assess what is going on and conduct clinical interviews for the same.

The psychologist then carefully takes the symptoms and compares them with diagnostic criteria. The assessment also helps distinguish if bipolar disorder is different from depression, anxiety, and ADHD, which has similar symptoms.

If a psychologist believes that bipolar disorder is there, the psychologist may recommend psychiatric evaluation for the same. This includes Medical confirmation and medication included. A psychologist in Delhi for bipolar disorder works closely with a psychiatrist to ensure that every person receives a comprehensive plan and care for their issues.

What are the Treatment Options Available for Bipolar Disorder?

Bipolar disorder has a good number of treatment options and many people also manage to be treated successfully. Treatment options here include-

  • – Mood Stabilising medication, which will be prescribed by a psychiatrist
  • – Cognitive behavioural therapy (CBT) for therapeutic treatment
  • – For families and individual individuals going through it, psycho education is a must
  • – Changes in lifestyle habits, including regular, sleep, and exercise
  • – Stress management techniques like meditation and focus strategies
  • – Family therapy, which helps strengthen communication and support
  • – Regular follow-up sessions

A Psychologist consultation in Delhi is something that helps people realise that building healthy coping skills and recognise early signs for long-term stability.

Expert Advice from Doctors

It is very important to know that ignoring frequent mood changes can be deteriorating for your daily life. Early assessment is important and chances of successful treatment increase with it. If you notice repeated periods of extreme happiness or sadness, consulting and experience, psychologist in Delhi, as soon as possible is the right way to go.
Early treatment helps people manage bipolar disorder more effectively.

Consult an Expert Today

If you are someone you love is experiencing these changes and is in need of any help, do not delay. A qualified psychologist in Delhi for bipolar disorder is the right person to go for a detailed assessment and assess the findings. Early care gives you the best chance to manage symptoms and improve your life for the long run.
