contentHtml:
In today’s fast-paced world where everyone is busy, we often overlook mental health which plays an important role in overall well-being. Depression is often common but at the same time it is a complex mental health condition that affects so many people across the globe. 

If you are living in Delhi, then search for the best psychiatrist in Delhi for depression. This will help you get professionals who can help you deal with the issues that this problem brings. Let’s discuss various strategies one by one. If you are someone looking for genuine help from professionals, then first of all knowing the right skills that help you to cope can help you to overcome depression.

Let’s Understand Depression

Before we discuss further conditions and find out coping ways to deal with them, first it becomes very important to understand what exactly depression is. Depression is a constant state of feeling sad, lost and without purpose or motivation. It not only interferes with daily activities but also overall mental health. 

Here are some symptoms of depression 

  • constantly feeling sad
  • feeling tired every day
  • losing interest in usual hobbies
  • Struggling to concentrate
  • Feeling hopeless in every situation
  • Lack of proper sleep (Insomnia), too much sleep (hypersomnia) and overeating.

There are various reasons behind depression that can include genetics, constant stress, trauma, and chemical imbalances in the brain. With a holistic approach it becomes easy to diagnose and treat the root causes of depression.  Providing support to such individuals to give them long-lasting relief becomes easier in such cases.

How the Best Psychiatrist in Delhi Can Help

1. Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)

Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) is known for the most effective ways of psychotherapy when it comes to treating depression. The best psychiatrist in Delhi for depression will always recommend CBT for treatment. This is because it focuses only on detecting and finding out those negative thought patterns. Since it contributes to symptoms of severe depression, it becomes easy to change them with this therapy. Replacing dangerous thoughts with healthier ones, especially realistic ones, will help individuals cope easily.

With the help of CBT, any individual suffering from severe depression can recognize these symptoms and allow them to challenge unhelpful thoughts and beliefs. This leads to the best sense of control over their emotional state. CBT guides you in problem-solving skills and helps you in developing coping mechanisms. It manages stress which is important to deal with long-term depression.

2. Practice Meditation and Mindfulness

Another way to overcome severe depression is to live a healthy life through meditation and mindfulness. Regularly practicing mindfulness helps to focus in the present moment. It guides every individual to be aware of their thoughts and emotions. This allows them to deal with negative thinking patterns that result in depression.

On the other hand, meditation always encourages you to relax and promotes emotional well-being by overcoming anxiety and stress. Experts for depression always recommend their patients perform mindfulness-based stress reduction (MBSR) techniques. It helps them to stay rooted and  manage negative emotions as well as overcome the depressive episodes intensities.

3. Physical Activity

Physical activity is considered as one of the most important aspects for managing severe mental health conditions. Various studies tell us the importance of regular exercise and how it can drastically decrease the symptoms of depression.  By alleviating mood-regulating chemicals such as dopamine and serotonin, it can deal with anxiety and stress.

As the best psychiatrist in Delhi for depression, our experts will give genuine advice to individuals suffering from depression. Introducing physical activity in their daily routine like yoga, exercising, and intense workouts can be powerful tools for management.

4. Developing Good Sleeping Habits

Lack of sleep (insomnia) or sleeping too much (hypersomnia) can result in deteriorating symptoms related to depression. This can create a harder situation to deal with. One of the best ways to emphasize this is to develop a healthy sleep habit among individuals.

To improve sleep quality, avoid caffeine or using electronic gadgets before bed. This helps improve the emotional regulation as well as overcome feelings of hopelessness or sadness.

5. Healthy Diet

Nutrition plays a crucial role when it comes to improving overall mental health. A balanced diet is rich in minerals, vitamins, and healthy fats that supports & boosts energy levels, regulating mood.  Experts suggest one thing- to focus on a nutrient rich diet. This includes whole foods, vegetables, fruits, omega-3 fatty acids, and lean proteins. There are certain nutrients like B vitamins and magnesium that have been proven to support overall brain health and help in overcoming symptoms related to depression.

6. Emotional Support and Social Connection

Individuals having depression often withdraw themselves from friends, family, and social activities. Social support does play an important role in recovery. The experts recommend individuals to talk to loved ones or take part in support groups.

Having a conversation with a friend you trust or a family member about your feelings does help in providing emotional support and relief and helps in developing a sense of connection.

Ways to Find Out the Best Psychiatrist Near Me

 Look for those professionals who have decades of experience in treating depression and provide a proper treatment plan according to your needs. The top psychiatrist in Delhi for depression can provide a great amount of knowledge on this. Their facility has advanced tools that can help you manage these symptoms and develop a better coping strategy.

Search online for the best psychiatrist or get recommendations from sources that are trusted. It becomes necessary and important to find a psychiatrist with whom you can feel comfortable and confident. Whether you prefer in-person consultation or online therapy is up to you to decide.

Approach our facility today.

Dealing with serious mental health conditions like depression and overcoming it can be overwhelming. Consulting the right psychiatrist with polished skills, it is possible to bring back control of your life. 

Recovery is possible when you are seeking professional help from the experts approaching to manage your depression practically. If you know anyone who is ready to take the initial step toward the journey for recovery, then reach out to the best of the best psychiatrists in Delhi for depression now. With better guidance and better strategies to cure, you will begin your journey toward healing.

It shows a pattern of unnecessary thoughts and fears that lead you to do repetitive behaviors. These obsessions as well as compulsions do get in the way of daily activities that cause severe distress.

People who are suffering from this condition do get thoughts like recurrent and persistent thoughts which can be unwanted. It can interfere with their personal lives, daily work, and relationships.

It can severely impact overall physical health as well like cardiovascular disease, having self-harm or suicidal thoughts, skin conditions and getting physical urges which are fake like the feeling of urinating regularly even though you are not feeling like that. h1: Understanding the Personality Disorders
excerpt: What is Personality Disorder and its Treatment by the Best Psychiatrist in Delhi Mental health is an integral part of overall well-being which also plays an important role in keeping physical health fit. Personality disorders are among the most stigmatized and misunderstood mental health issues where they impact an individual’s patterns of behaving, thinking, and […]
contentHtml:
What is Personality Disorder and its Treatment by the Best Psychiatrist in Delhi

Mental health is an integral part of overall well-being which also plays an important role in keeping physical health fit. Personality disorders are among the most stigmatized and misunderstood mental health issues where they impact an individual’s patterns of behaving, thinking, and feeling leading to harsh challenges in professional and personal relationships. With proper care, people with personality disorders can live a fulfilling life. Taking help from the best psychiatrist in Delhi is a mandatory step towards recovery.

Personality disorders are one of the mental health conditions where people have a lifelong pattern of seeking themselves and reacting to others in ways that cause problems. Individuals facing this issue often have a hard time understanding emotions and tolerating distress. They act impulsively which makes it harder for them to relate to others, which causes serious conditions and affects their family life, social activities, school and work performance, and overall quality of life. Such disorders often begin in early adulthood or adolescence.

Types of Personality Disorders

1. Cluster A (Eccentric or Odd Disorders):

Paranoid Personality Disorder: Excessive amount of mistrust and suspicion of others.

Schizoid Personality Disorder: Detachment from interpersonal relationships and general disinterest in emotional expression.

Schizotypal Personality Disorder: Distorted views of reality, superstitions, and unusual behaviors may hinder intense discomfort in close relationships.

2. Cluster B (Emotional, Dramatic, or Erratic Disorders):

  • Antisocial Personality Disorder (APSD): Lack of respect toward others and refusal to follow rules.
  • Borderline Personality Disorder (BPD): Struggle with emotional regulation, resulting in low self-esteem, mood swings, and impulsive behaviors.
  • Histrionic Personality Disorder: Excessively dependent on others for physical and emotional needs.
  • Narcissistic Personality Disorder: Constant need for praise and admiration and a lack of empathy for others.

3. Cluster C (Fearful or Anxious Disorders):

  • Avoidant Personality Disorder: Highly intense fear of criticism and social insecurity.
  • Dependent Personality Disorder: Too much dependence on others for physical and emotional needs.
  • Obsessive-Compulsive Personality Disorder (OCPD): Consistent and extreme need for perfectionism and orderliness.
  • Such conditions do coexist with other mental health issues like anxiety, depression, or substance abuse which makes comprehensive treatment crucial. To deal with this, Consulting with the best psychiatrist in Delhi always ensures ways to access tailored treatment plans for effective management.

Symptoms and Causes of Personality Disorders

Symptoms :

  • Difficulty in interpersonal relationships.
  • Too sensitive to rejection or criticism.
  • Strange or unpredictable behavior.
  • Extreme mood swings or emotional outbursts.

Causes:

  • Childhood traumatic events like abuse or neglect.
  • Family history of mental health issues like fear, aggression and anxiety.
  • Abnormalities in brain functioning or chemistry.

  • If you or anyone you know personally recognizes these signs, then reaching out to the best psychiatrist in Delhi will give you the proper diagnosis and treatment.

Diagnosis and Treatment

Diagnose:

  • A detailed evaluation of personal relationships, medical symptoms and history.
  • A proper discussion about your thoughts, behavior and feelings.
  • Behavior patterns analysis over time.

When symptoms coexist with conditions like bipolar disorder or schizophrenia, then early diagnosis is critical for effective treatment. The best psychiatrist in Delhi for schizophrenia provides specialized care if it is needed.

Treatment:

1. Psychotherapy:

  • Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT): Helps identify patterns and change negative thoughts.
  • Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT): Helps to learn skills to manage emotions and behavior.
  • Psychodynamic Therapy: Exploration of unconscious feelings and past experiences to improve behavior.

2. Medication:

  • No specific medication to treat personality disorder specifically. But you may be prescribed them to manage certain feelings or behaviors or other mental health problems like depression or anxiety.
  • Any person dealing with severe mood instability, get a consult with a bipolar disorder specialist to ensure proper care.

3. Family Therapy:

  • It helps you to improve communication and support within your family and create a healthier environment for recovery.

4. Group Therapy

  • It encourages people to share their experiences and learn from others who are facing similar challenges.

Specialized Treatment for Related Disorders

1. Schizophrenia:

It is a severe mental health disorder that affects how a person behaves, thinks, and feels. It has symptoms such as delusions, hallucinations, and impaired cognitive functioning. Getting help from the best psychiatrist in Delhi for schizophrenia always ensures access to advanced antipsychotic medications and therapy to get better management of the condition.

2. Bipolar Disorder:

It is characterized by extreme mood swings that range from manic highs to depressive lows. A bipolar disorder specialist employs a combination of psychotherapy and mood stabilizers to help patients achieve emotional balance and live a stable life.

3. Depression:

A common co-occurring condition with personality disorders is marked by persistent sadness, loss of interest in activities, and lack of energy. The best psychiatrist in Delhi for depression provides treatment through antidepressants and evidence-based psychotherapies to alleviate symptoms and restore well-being.

Breaking the Stigma

Despite the awareness related to mental health issues like personality disorders, still it is being stigmatized. This can discourage individuals from taking help for their severe condition they need. Just like physical health, mental health recognition is an important thing to encourage timely intervention.

Take Initiative

This journey requires ongoing support and a trusted professional psychiatrist will guide you every step of the way. If you or someone you know personally is suffering from a severe personality disorder or any related mental health condition, do not hesitate to reach out to the best psychiatrist in Delhi who can transform your life like any other normal human being. With their decades of expertise and compassionate care, you should navigate the challenges of such disorders and move toward recovery. Do not let that stigma around mental health stop you from taking the first step further for the initiative. Remember one thing, taking help is always a sign of stepping toward empowerment and healing, not a sign of weakness. Do not delay and wait for change, get up and reach out today and take care of your mental health just like physical health because it is the only thing which can improve your overall well-being. Visit us at Tulasi healthcare today and discover a new found transformation in your lives.

h1: Routine and Mindfulness is the Way: From the lens of Bipolar Disorder Specialists
excerpt: Routine and Mindfulness is the Way: From the lens of Bipolar Disorder Specialists Our mood and emotions rule a significant portion of our lifestyle, given they regulate our actions and behavior in most scenarios. contentHtml:
Our mood and emotions rule a significant portion of our lifestyle, given they regulate our actions and behavior in most scenarios. When they suffer a blow, everything turns upside down. Bipolar disorder is a mood disorder where extreme shifts in mood and emotions occur. This makes the person rash, relentless and void of the capacity to take rational decisions. When this happens, there are a lot of factors at play.

Managing bipolar disorder requires a comprehensive and personalized approach. Bipolar disorder specialists play a crucial role in helping individuals navigate their symptoms and improve their quality of life.

Specialists like psychiatrists, psychologists, therapists & counselors can offer critical support in managing bipolar disorder. Not only do they help with managing the symptoms but also provide great lifestyle strategies. It helps individuals in their daily routines to maintain stability.

Today we’ll explore how bipolar disorder specialists help individuals manage this condition. We focus on day-to-day life, with their roles in treatment, ongoing support, and long-term management.

1- Comprehensive and Personalized Treatment Plan

Obtaining an accurate diagnosis is essential for properly managing and personalizing the treatment plan. While the symptoms of bipolar disorder are simple to understand and observe, they are often confused with other psychological conditions. These can be depression, anxiety, or personality disorders. Through an in-depth evaluation, which can usually take several sessions, it is easy to identify the disorder.

Once a diagnosis is confirmed, a specialist is assigned to the individual. They manage the case & develop a personalized treatment plan tailored to their unique needs. This plan might include medication, psychotherapy, lifestyle modifications, and ongoing monitoring as per the condition of the client. The benefit of working with a specialist is that they can adjust the treatment plan based on the individual’s response. With evolving symptoms they can ensure that it remains pertinent in managing daily life issues.

2- Medication Management & Monitoring

Medications can help regulate mood swings, reduce  severity of episodes, and prevent future complications such as relapses. However, finding the right medication and dosage can be a trial-and-error process, as different individuals respond to medications differently.

Typical medication that is prescribed include mood stabilizers, antipsychotics, antidepressants, and anticonvulsants

For instance, if a person has side effects like weight gain, fatigue, or sleep disturbances, the specialist may change the medication. The dosage can also be managed to minimize these effects while still managing mood swings.

Regular follow-ups are essential. Ongoing monitoring of medication effectiveness is ensured and individuals achieve the right balance to function in their daily lives. Moreover, bipolar disorder specialists can educate individuals on the importance of medication treatment and its role in managing bipolar disorder. This guidance helps individuals in keeping non-negligence at bay and ensuring overall wellbeing.

3. Psychotherapy and Counseling

While medication can take care  of the biochemical issues, psychotherapy enables individuals with coping strategies to navigate daily challenges. It improves emotional regulation, and manages stress effectively. Bipolar disorder specialists, including psychologists and licensed therapists offer different types of therapy that play an essential role in day-to-day management.

a) Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)

CBT is one of the most effective therapies for individuals with bipolar disorder. It is focused on identifying and changing negative thought patterns, addressing maladaptive behaviors, and teaching normative ways of thinking. For example, CBT can equip people with bipolar disorder to identify the early warning signs of a manic or depressive episode. These can be anywhere from changes in sleep patterns to irritability in day to day tasks. By understanding these signs early a preventive action can be taken.

b) Family-Focused Therapy (FFT)

Bipolar disorder specialists also focus on providing family-focused therapy, which involves educating family members about the disorder. This is essential because of a variety of reasons. It teaches effective communication strategies and provides tools for managing crises. Family as a unit suffers in a lot of ways. It is not only tolling on the client but the ones surrounding them too. Family involvement is essential because loved ones play a significant role. They observe and address the warning signs of mood episodes and offer necessary emotional support. FFT builds a supportive home environment that reduces stress and conflict for the client.  This is effective for stabilizing mood swings and improving symptoms.

4- Early Intervention and Support

Early intervention is the key to managing any kind of psychological and physiological condition. When it comes to bipolar disorder, it can be a crucial step. Changes in behavior, sleep, or thought patterns are key indicators in pinpointing at any kind of disorder.  A good crisis intervention plan can be made based upon just small observations.It leaves a deep and lasting impact on the client’s well being. As experts, we believe that any small step can become life saving for an individual’s psyche.

Engaging in group counselling and connecting with other peers suffering from the same conditions is also necessary. It adds a perspective that is essential for the clients to understand their illness better and shed a positive light on it. We believe that fostering a sense of community well being is essential for a holistic development of the clients. Tulasi healthcare is all about evolving and reaching for the better when it comes to pursuing the best for our clients.

Changing for the better is now Possible

An illness can change a lot in our lives. From emotional to behavioral issues, we are prone to levels of trauma when we deny help from an expert. With our bipolar disorder specialists, you can achieve a healthy lifestyle in a matter of weeks and transform for a better lifestyle. When you approach Tulasi healthcare you are stepping into a space of calmness, unfettered support and constant care. Our judgement free, confidential environment is a safe haven for anyone who wants to live, change and do better with themselves. To know how we can help you achieve your mental health goals and guide you on a better path, connect with us and visit our facility today.

title: Female Sexual Disorders: Treatment options with Best Sexologist in Delhi
h1: Prevalence in Indian Subcontinent
excerpt: Sexual issues are a problem that are a taboo within themselves to address, let alone dealing with it as a woman can be quite a difficult task. Even when the society has progressed to new heights, women still face anxiety and a reserved mindset when it comes to talking about their sexual issues. In the […]
contentHtml:
Sexual issues are a problem that are a taboo within themselves to address, let alone dealing with it as a woman can be quite a difficult task. Even when the society has progressed to new heights, women still face anxiety and a reserved mindset when it comes to talking about their sexual issues. In the case of the Indian subcontinent itself, talking about sexual activities in itself is seen as a heinous act, let alone talk about the problem one faces due to it. As the best sexologist in Delhi, Dr. Gorav Gupta shares his wisdom on the topic. Through these blogs and encourages people to come forward with their problems. 

It is very important for people to seek a practitioner who specializes in the area. It is not everyone’s cup of tea to resolve issues as complex as these. To know the right way, let us first see what is the prevalence of this issue in the Indian subcontinent. In India itself, a large number of women face sexual disorders. According to a study published in Journal of Human Sexuality, a huge number- about 60% of women have experienced some form of sexual disorder in their lifetime. This is a significant number- given the level of healthcare access and awareness programs running at grassroot levels. 

Reasons behind Such Large Numbers

There are a variety of factors at play here. Cultural hindrances, lack of sexual awareness, psychoeducation, traditional expectations from gender roles, societal expectations and familial pressures keep women from sharing their issues with the right source. Pointless discussions with less educated adults lead to dangerous and unwanted solutions that produce results beyond our expectations. 

Understanding Sexual Dysfunction in Women

  • Hypoactive sexual desire disorder (low libido)– It’s when a woman experiences low sexual desire and does not naturally have the urge to engage in sexual intercourse. According to one of the best  Female sexologist in Delhi, it is a highly reported issue. It is due to the presence of a sedentary lifestyle, bringing stress, anxiety and depression into the picture. Such women feel disconnected with their sexuality. They may often face issues sustaining their relationships in the long run. 
  • Sexual arousal disorder– In this disorder, the woman faces issues becoming aroused and having excitement for intercourse. There is a complete lack of arousal in this case, as opposed to hypoactive condition. Physical and psychological factors, per se, play a crucial role in determining the absence of arousal. This may be due to trauma, abuse, physical issues, or side effects of medications.When talking to an expert, these are the points to be mentioned for a better diagnosis. 
  • Dyspareunia– Also known as painful intercourse, this condition can be a result of various factors. These can include problems like- vaginal dryness, infections or endometriosis. This can cause fear of pain that can lead to significant distress and strained relationships with sexual partner, if not resolved. 
  • Anorgasmia– This is the inability to reach orgasm, even when the woman has achieved enough arousal for intercourse. This can also be a result of different factors that include physiological as well as psychological symptoms. 
  • Vaginismus– This is the involuntary contraction of vaginal muscles that makes penetration quite painful for the woman. This can also be called significant problems for the male partner. This often has issues rooted in psychological aspects that include trauma, abuse or fear of sexual experiences. 

Treatment Options from Best Sexologist in Delhi

Addressing female sexual disorders in a country like ours should be a personalized and protected approach, keeping in mind the cultural norms and breaking the barriers of addressing such crucial issues. 

  • Cognitive Behavioral Therapy– Since sexual issues can also result from a psychological factor, talk therapy can be used. CBT works as a result of resolving issues with misaligned thought patterns. These patterns affect the behavior and adaptation of the individual. In cases of sexual disorders women can opt for CBT as a first line treatment, according to some of the best female sexologist in Delhi. CBT can help women identify their negative thought patterns around sexual activity and eliminate possibilities of physical issues. This can highly impact their sexual issues positively in the long run. 
  • Medical interventions– Medical interventions are a crucial part when it comes to resolving issues of reproductive nature. When the issue stems from physiological causes, physical therapy and medication are necessary. Hormonal imbalances, menopause, and other health issues can impact a woman’s libido and sexual arousal. Hormone therapy, such as estrogen and testosterone replacement, may be recommended in cases where hormonal deficiencies are detected. These therapies can help resolve symptoms like vaginal dryness, decreased arousal, and pain during intercourse.For women experiencing sexual pain or discomfort, treatments such as vaginal moisturizers, lubricants, and local estrogen creams can be effective.
  • Couples therapy–  Couples therapy can be a very effective way to resolve sexual issues in women. Sometimes, the dynamics may not be as per the set standards of the female, causing issues in intimate relations. Poor communication, unresolved conflicts, and emotional problems can highly disrupt intimacy. Couples therapy can help partners better understand each other’s needs, communicate more openly, and work together to rebuild emotional and physical intimacy.
  • Pelvic floor therapy– This is utilized in cases where physical issues are recognized behind sexual issues. Here, certain activities are prescribed from problems like vaginal tightness, pain during intercourse, and pelvic organ prolapse. A specialized therapist can guide exercises that strengthen and relax pelvic muscles, improving sexual comfort and function.

What do the Best Sexologist in Delhi Suggest?

Sexual dysfunction can become a real crisis if not addressed. It is crucial to seek professional help. If you are looking for a holistic approach that addresses physical, psychological, and relational factors, our team of experts can be your guide. In Delhi, where options for specialized care are abundant, seeking the best female sexologist in Delhi can help you receive personalized, evidence-based treatment. Our experts can help you with tailored treatment options, offering support to overcome the barriers to a fulfilling sexual life. Take the first step toward healing by consulting with our qualified specialists today.

title: Signs of Alcoholism
h1: How to Identify and Assess Alcoholism?
excerpt: How to Identify and Assess Alcoholism? Alcoholism is a rising concern amongst the Indian population, not limited to just urban population. People in every strata of the society suffer from its brunt, but only a few choose to report its effects to an expert. The lack of confidence, awareness and excessive taboo has rendered people […]
contentHtml:
Alcoholism is a rising concern amongst the Indian population, not limited to just urban population. People in every strata of the society suffer from its brunt, but only a few choose to report its effects to an expert. The lack of confidence, awareness and excessive taboo has rendered people unable to seek help, thus making their lives problematic on a daily basis.

Alcohol use disorder, commonly known as alcoholism, is a quite common condition where people get dependent upon alcohol use to carry out their daily lives, no matter how severely it has affected their bodily and psychological functioning. They are unable to distinguish between regular use and excessive intake. This progression can be mild, moderate or severe in nature.

But one might wonder- ‘How much is too much?’ According to the American Medical Association, there is a two drink per day limit for people assigned male at birth. Heavy drinking goes beyond five drinks a day. For people assigned female at birth, there is a limit of one drink per day, and heavy drinking goes beyond four drinks a day. If this pattern continues for a long time, it is indicative of the onset of alcoholism.

What are the causes behind Alcoholism?

Usually, researches cannot comprehend an exact reason behind the development of alcoholism as a disorder, but the certain factors that majorly contribute to it include- Genetics- People who have a family history of alcohol abuse have a heightened risk of developing it. This may not be true for everyone, but many people do experience this. Mental health issues- Psychological issues are highly responsible for contributing to alcoholism in the long run. Conditions like PTSD, ADHD, depression and anxiety contribute to it.

Alcohol Addiction Symptoms

When you focus on the symptoms of alcohol addiction as a condition, there are various signs that you can spot if you focus keenly. Many of us as close associates of the individual fail to understand the problem, which can include-

-Craving substances that include alcohol Developing a high tolerance for alcoholic beverages
-Continuing the acts of consumption even when these affect the personal, professional and occupational aspects of the individual’s life.
-Spending a majority of time acquiring alcoholic beverages and dedicating it to its consumption.
-Setting a limit to drinking and not abiding by it.
-Feeling withdrawal symptoms when not consuming alcohol for even a short period of time.
-Continuing alcohol use even in physically and mentally hazardous situations.
Giving up on important social, occupational and personal tasks to prioritize alcohol use.

When such signs and symptoms begin to show up, it is essential that a person searches up for a ‘de addiction center near me’ and visit it as soon as possible to figure out a treatment plan. An early intervention can prove quite beneficial when supported and cared for by the right experts.

Management and Treatment Plans for Alcoholism

When treated by the experts at our facility, you will find that you are in the best environment possible to tackle alcohol addiction. Our team of 100+ experts pour in their best efforts to figure out the best regime for your care.

Let’s take a look at what suggested therapies and medications can be utilized for alcoholism- Behavioral treatment- Behavioral treatment works wonders when it comes to resolving alcoholism. With treatment modalities like-

Cognitive behavioral therapy–
This therapy is highly beneficial when it comes to utilizing the power of changing thought process to enhance behavior. This is highly beneficial when the person can realize the power that their irrational thoughts hold on them and change them to influence their behavior in a better manner. Since alcoholism is a behavior powered by maladaptive thoughts, this therapy has proven quite beneficial.

Dialectical Behavior Therapy-
Dialectical behavior therapy targets the emotional dysregulation which is a very common factor playing a crucial role in developing alcoholism. With this therapy, a person can easily control and become aware of their thoughts, thus making them capable of managing their condition in the long run.

Counselling and talk therapy-
Sometimes, it is necessary to go to the depths of the issue before providing a solution for it. When it comes to talk therapy, a client can open up about their problems, discuss their issues and set out on a journey of self discovery and rectification.

Pharmacological treatment-
Detoxification is a necessary step when it comes to treating alcohol use disorder. Introducing medication into the system is necessary to control hormonal and physical imbalances of the body and allow other therapies and interventions to work. This intervention is applied only for a short period of time to prevent addiction issues.

Self help groups-
Self help groups are a necessary intervention plan for individuals suffering from alcoholism. Groups like Alcoholics Anonymous are a global network of individuals. They extend their support to recovering alcoholics. Similarly, various support groups are also available to join and contribute in the local vicinity in every town and area near you.

I drink every night- Am I a Alcoholic?

If you are someone who is having such thoughts- you might be in need of help. This, of course, also depends upon the level of consumption that one has. As explained by the American Medical Association, when one crosses their drink limit each day and maintains this threshold for a longer period of time, it might be quite an indication to ask yourselves this question.

Looking for Help?

If you are looking for answers to some particular questions like this and find yourselves resonating quite much with them, it is time to seek help. When you approach deaddiction centre in Delhi NCR( Tulasi healthcare), you are in the care and support of people who truly care about your wellbeing. When you come to us with your issues, a team of experts and caregivers stands behind you.  They nurture you with their support and guidance. To know how you can transform and become a better version of yourselves, connect with us today or visit our website www.tulasihealthcare.com

h1: How to Seek help for Female Sexual Disorders? How to approach an Expert?
excerpt: How to Seek help for Female Sexual Disorders? How to approach an Expert? Human body encompasses multiple systems, with each holding their own uniqueness and issues. Sexual dysfunctions can be a hard pill to swallow, since it holds an integral part in an individual’s life. One of our most primal needs as humans, it can […]
contentHtml:
Human body encompasses multiple systems, with each holding their own uniqueness and issues. Sexual dysfunctions can be a hard pill to swallow, since it holds an integral part in an individual’s life. One of our most primal needs as humans, it can cause significant issues in our daily functioning. When it comes to females especially, their reproductive health dictates a variety of functions throughout their body. Any imbalance can significantly impact their behavior, mood and even impair functioning. To understand this, women need to be aware about the issues they can encounter with their sexual functioning and enquire about the symptoms they are facing.

Let’s understand the different sexual disorders women can develop and how they can approach treatment with the help of an expert.

What Symptoms to look for before Expert Opinion?

It may not always be very obvious to spot the problems you experience with your sexual activity. These may present one way or the other, and a vigilant eye is all that you need. Let’s explore some common symptoms to keep an eye on.

Low sexual desire– It can be due to the daily tasks and demands of the situation, but if it persists continuously for a longer period of time, this may be something you want to get addressed.

Low arousal- While indulging in sexual activity, it might happen that you may not feel as intimate or aroused as one should. It can be counted as a symptom if this continues to persist on a regular basis, and not just a sole occurrence.

Orgasmic issues– Even with enough sexual arousal, you might feel that you are not able to orgasm, and this problem has stayed for a significant amount of time.

Experiencing pain– If you are experiencing pain during sexual activity and it has not been just a sole occurrence, it may be something you might need to report.

What Disorders can you Experience?

The female reproductive system is quite complex and sexually intricate. Any small change can trigger the issues that one cannot begin to comprehend at an early stage. With this in mind, let’s take a look at different disorders that one might face.

Female sexual arousal disorder– Female sexual arousal disorder is one of the highest female sexual disorders reported. Such women are not interested in engaging in sexual activities, feel lesser arousal level than their counterparts and are not preoccupied by the thoughts of intimate activities even while engaging in them. They are not particularly excited about it and like to perform it as another chore in their day. They may also find that their genital and erogenous zones are not as stimulated as they used to be. Any problems in the physical structure of the body responsible for arousal can result in female sexual arousal disorder. Both hormonal and psychological causes are behind its manifestation which can include problems like low self esteem, relationship problems, trauma, guilt and stress amongst many others.

Treatment options for this can include medication and hormonal therapy along with psychological therapies to help aid the recovery process.

Female orgasmic disorder– Female orgasmic disorder takes a keen eye to diagnose, since many women are not able to distinguish if and when they have had an orgasm. The lack of education on the subject can serve as a contradiction. However, identifying it is in the hands of an expert. A delayed, infrequent or absent orgasm for a persistent period of time can be counted as a marker. Distress in relationships and external stressors may also cause problems in orgasm. This may also have some medical reasons for it – some physical abnormality or neurological issue that may result in delayed or absence of an orgasm altogether. Anxiety and depression can also be strong markers. For its treatment, an individual can be presented with psychotherapy as the first line of treatment. Apart from this, they can also resort to medication as well as sex therapy with some good mental hospital in Delhi.

Female Hypoactive Sexual Desire Disorder (HSDD)– Hypoactvity can be defined as absence or little presence. In this case, a female does not have any sexual drive at all or does not have enough to initiate sexual contact with their partner. HSDD is quite common in females and can happen over time. HSDD may seem like an issue that has gone out of hand, but not to worry- it has its own ways to manage and reignite the spark of living a satisfactory life. Understanding the causes behind it can provide water to resolve and manage it in the long run. The causes can be quite common problems like stress, depression and anxiety, or result from lasting problems in the relationship. To manage and treat this issue, medical and psychiatric advice is necessary. Individuals can approach an expert on their own or with their partner for an effective and detailed consultation. Medications, sex therapy, exercising and good old holistic interventions are the predefined treatment plans. In case of other changes and complications, your healthcare advisor or psychologist can guide you accordingly and make changes in your management plan.

These issues may seem serious and unmanageable to people who do not have any psychoeducation regarding them and have not approached an expert yet.

Looking to Seek Expert Opinion? Tulasi’s Team is here for You.

A sexual issue in itself a private affair, and having psychological roots associated with it may raise taboos beyond comprehension. But as responsible individuals, it is upon us to take care of our body and mind. Seeking the right treatment with an expert is our prerogative. At Tulasi, we have the best sexologists in Delhi who are dedicated to helping you in every possible way. We all have a duty to ourselves, our mind and our body- and it is necessary to understand for our own well being and functioning in the society. To know how we can help you with issues of intimate nature and resolve your concerns, connect with us today or visit our facility at the earliest.

title: OCD Treatment Options and Management Strategies
h1: OCD Treatment Options and Management Strategies
excerpt: Understanding Intricacies linked to OCD: Treatment Options and Management Strategies Obsessions and compulsions can bring chaos into one’s lives, especially when one is not able to identify the effect of its intricacies. When a person goes through Obsessive and Compulsive Disorder, they are damaging every aspect of their lives, without even a faint realization of […]
contentHtml:
Understanding Intricacies linked to OCD: Treatment Options and Management Strategies

Obsessions and compulsions can bring chaos into one’s lives, especially when one is not able to identify the effect of its intricacies. When a person goes through Obsessive and Compulsive Disorder, they are damaging every aspect of their lives, without even a faint realization of it. They take it as their eccentricity, and fail to acknowledge that a problem persists in their behavior. This not only affects them, but a whole lot of interactions and tasks they perform on a daily basis.

This is an issue that is best discovered by the people around the afflicted individual. OCD can disrupt every norm, and land people in situations that can be quite uncomfortable for them. There is an order in the chaos of this world, and OCD can diminish the power in our sights to see this. The manifestation usually shows up when the person is truly into a spiral of his obsessions and compulsions. Insight development is essential, and you can approach mental health experts around you to find the right way.  Dr. Gorav Gupta is one of the best psychiatrists in Delhi for the treatment of OCD and he can guide you to an ultimately transformative journey from your mental health condition.

Treatment options and management strategies play a huge role in identifying the future course of action and relapse prevention. For knowing these, a proper diagnosis must be made to ensure that the treatment plans are intricate and accurate in every manner possible.

Diagnosis Procedure for OCD

OCD is a condition that may not need an in-depth diagnosis for it, but for exploring its manifestation and intricacies it plays an important role. OCD can manifest in a variety of manners, and finding out crucial details along with its root cause play a major role in determining the treatment plan. To handle this, psychological assessments and physical examinations can be performed.

  • Psychological assessment– This is a very essential part of diagnosis that involves history taking, assessment and tool application along with behavioral observation to add certainty to the diagnostic procedure.
  • Physical examinations– These are performed to know if any physical issue lies behind the psychological manifestation of the disorder. Any abuse, trauma or genetic predisposition is assessed.

Treatment Options for OCD with Best Psychiatrist in Delhi

Treatment for OCD involves much intricate planning, since a specific thought pattern and behavior needs to be targeted. OCD has many treatment plans, with good non-traditional methods that are also FDA approved. Keeping this in mind, let us discuss some highly effective and widely used treatment plans that are usually consumed for the treatment and management of OCD.

  • Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)– A first line treatment plan for OCD, it focuses on the thoughts and behavioral patterns that result in the manifestation of OCD. This is done in an effort to help the patient realize their thoughts, actions and patterns and familiarize them to the problem they are facing and raise acceptance. One can gain insight into their faulty thought patterns and adopt new strategies to counter the effect of maladaptive thoughts.
  • Exposure and response prevention (ERP)– As the name suggests, exposure and response prevention therapy helps the person get broadly associated with the stimuli that induces their compulsions and obsessions, gradually building a certain tolerance to it over time and reducing its effects on the person’s behavior. The person is encouraged to indulge in the situation or act, but not compulsively react to them. Over time, this behavior is moulded under supervision and the anxiety related to this behavior and thought pattern subsides. The pace of this exposure depends upon the insight and willingness of the person to approach their treatment.
  • Deep Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (dTMS)– There might be times when the issue lies in the physiological structures, and cannot be handled with psychotherapy and medication alone. To tackle this, dTMS is used. It used magnetic waves to target structures responsible for the disorder and alleviate the symptoms. An FDA approved treatment option, this brain stimulation technique is highly effective in severe cases of OCD. Since it is a non-invasive therapy, it does not have any physical implications and can diminish relapse of the condition.
  • Psychopharmacology– Another first line of treatment method to tackle OCD, medications should be taken according to the prescription and assessment made by a psychiatrist. With consultations from a psychiatrist in gurgaon or Delhi for OCD, you can get to know the right kind of medication that can manage the severity and manage the symptoms along with other therapeutic methods. Very handful of medications are cleared by the FDA to treat OCD and other conditions that result due to its comorbidity, and SSRIs prove to be the best selections. Medications usually work the best when they are combined with therapies, discussions and holistic methods of care.
  • Psychodynamic therapy– Psychodynamic therapy explores the unconscious motives and reasons behind the person’s current condition, specifically the impact of family, peers and environment. The treatment explores where the person comes from, how they developed a sense of self in relation to their environment and how it has shaped their behavior as of today. With psychodynamic therapy, these unconscious motives are surfaced, and the person deals with them in a conscious manner, realizing their anxiety inducing thoughts and moving away from it in a gradual manner. Over time, this anxiety is replaced by insight, and positive actions, or in this case, obsessions and compulsions are replaced by normative behavior.

OCD does not have to Rule your Narrative.

When a mental disorder takes over one’s life, it is all they can think about. The disruptions it brings along can be quite damaging. Many aspects of one’s life suffer, rendering them to reevaluate their life. With Tulasi healthcare, you rule your narrative and the transformation that comes with it. With some of the best psychiatrists in Delhi under one roof, you receive the best of healthcare. The power of support, motivation and positive environment is realized through our actions, and we are dedicated to providing it at all costs.

contentHtml:
Building a Calm Approach Towards Anxiety: How to Approach Treatment

Pursuing treatment for any disorder is a task. Being clueless about one’s condition can only foster confusion- a bad road to take when one needs help the most. To deal with such issues, experts at Tulasi Healthcare step up to help our readers and anyone who seeks guidance. With one of the best psychiatrist in Delhi Dr. Gorav Gupta, you can be assured that you are in safe hands. With the wisdom of more than two decades, he provides his guidance on approaching treatment for anxiety in the best manner possible.

Many of us suffer from anxiety at one point or the other, and it is necessary in some ways to keep us motivated to complete a task. But when this optimal level is exceeded in the long run, it can result in anxiety disorders of all sorts. Anxiety can manifest  in a variety of ways such as Generalized Anxiety, Specific Anxiety, Phobia and what not. A single situation or trauma can trigger a response of the body which can be labeled as anxiety. When this response becomes unmanageable, it can cause hindrances in daily activities and severely affect many aspects of life. To deal with this, certain steps can be taken on the personal front if the problem is detected early. If not, interventions from an expert are necessary to ensure the wellbeing of the individual.

Let’s discover the best treatment methods for anxiety from the lens of an expert psychiatrist.

Treatment Plans for Anxiety Issues

Anxiety disorder can be understood as a state of mind where cognitive distortions repel the right thought patterns and mindset. This not only leads to a maladaptive behavior, but also a constant state of worrying, feeling nervous and all kinds of physical and psychological symptoms that sets a person on the edge.

Understanding what is going on with oneself is essential to take the first step towards treatment. Having an insight makes the process much easier.

  • Cognitive Behavioral Therapy– The basis of approaching cognitive therapy is to identify the thoughts that trigger maladaptive behavior and change them to influence the right behavior pattern.For example, when a person with social anxiety approaches a situation where social interaction is necessary, their thoughts will be linked to a state of worrying, being judged or nervousness that will lead them to feel uncomfortable or hyper fixated on their actions. This can result in erratic behaviors. The principle of CBT is to eliminate this erratic thought pattern and introduce a more positive, rational and appropriate thought process that can help the individual deal with their anxious patterns.
  • Exposure therapy– The best way to deal with anxiety is facing it in real time. Exposure therapy works on the principle of introducing the individual to situations that trigger anxiety, and moulding that behavior with active confrontation. This helps the person attach more realistic beliefs to their fears rather than irrational and unnecessary ones. With repeated exposures, the individual is desensitized to their fear and can handle its repercussions.
  • Systematic desensitization– As the name suggests, this therapy works on the principle of systematically removing the anxious behavior by recognizing the trigger and making conscious efforts towards it. The individual is prompted to make a list of their triggers and the procedure starts with the least fear inducing situation, gradually moving towards the core issue.
  • Relaxation techniques– These are one of the most effective methods for controlling anxiety and managing it in the long run. Mindfulness based meditations, breathing exercises & yogic activities are known for their efficacy in keeping anxiety at bay.since they are scientifically backed methods with high rate of success, they are actively coupled with other therapies and medications to produce a higher rate of success.
  • Biofeedback– An easy but effective method, biofeedback is used by many psychiatrists in gurgaon and Delhi to assess and identify the body’s anxiety triggers and help the client control them using relaxation techniques. These can include heart rate, muscular tension and breathing patterns to understand the effect of anxiety on the body.

How to make Anxiety Treatment Work for you?

Apart from therapeutic interventions, taking steps from the personal end are also necessary. This can lead to a tremendous change, even if small steps are taken. Since there is no quick fix, making positive choices is a must.

  • -Keep activity level high. This will ensure that your anxiety will be channelized in the right direction, and may also help you revive previous and new interests.
  • -Dietary adjustments are crucial to anxiety management. Magnesium deficiency, insufficient intake of Vitamin B and calcium is linked to anxiety disorders.
  • -The core of anxiety is sometimes linked to lack of assertiveness. When there is a lack of communication, asserting your opinion- it leads to an internal conflict.
  • -People with anxiety are often very conscious of their choices and actions, leading to their low self esteem. This can trigger a passive lifestyle and the need of not being noticed by others. It is essential to interact and openly communicate in this regard, starting slow with your closest connections. This will help you build self esteem and provide reassurances about your maladaptive thought patterns.
  • -According to one of the best psychiatrists in Delhi, structured problem solving is a very effective method in handling anxiety. It is a valuable skill that can help one attain structure in their life and move forward.

Found your Treatment Partner? Let the Best Psychiatrist in Delhi help you.

The word ‘treatment’ evokes feelings of dread and suffering in clients with mental health issues, but it does not have to be this way. With our team of experts at Tulasi Healthcare, you are under the safe haven of support, understanding and healing. We are not just a rehabilitation center- we are a place that provides people with a chance to transform their life without the fear of being judged and mistreated for their actions. If you seek to find the right place to start your journey, connect with our experts today.

h1: Depression- a common term but taboo follows it around
excerpt: Depression- a common term but taboo follows it around All of us have heard about depression at one moment or the other, and surely enough, many of us have even gone through it at some stage in life. With time, the awareness around it has made significant progress, making diagnosis at an earlier stage easy. […]
contentHtml:
All of us have heard about depression at one moment or the other, and surely enough, many of us have even gone through it at some stage in life. With time, the awareness around it has made significant progress, making diagnosis at an earlier stage easy. People have started to identify the symptoms and report it with their own understanding, but one question still remains- how are we able to tackle the problem in the long run?

Relapsing into this condition is also quite common, given the same circumstances can return anytime and if the person has not received the right treatment and coping strategies, they might not be able to handle the stressors and relapse into depression very easily. This leaves the healthcare professionals with an everlasting question- how can we define a treatment plan that has the power to manage and treat a patient in the long run, keeping their social, emotional and occupational well being and responsibilities in mind?

Depression can be a result of a myriad of factors that interplay within situations to bring about the onset. Not only this, but genetic, environmental and situational dispositions play a crucial role in determining how the individual responds to the conditions and to what severity it develops.

To understand the depth of this, we converse with one of the best psychiatrist in Delhi, Dr. Gorav Gupta and gain their insights on the best treatment plans for depression and the power of personalized treatment modalities in achieving wellness in the long run.

Treatment Plans for Depression

Treatment is generally taken from a wide perspective, narrowing down on interplaying factors, personal history and the symptoms presented during the onset of the issue. When enough data is in place, forming a diagnosis becomes easier and prioritization of presenting issues is clearly defined.

Treatment is first approached from the view of therapeutic adjustment, where mild to moderate cases of severity are treated without the use of medical interventions and tackled with cognitive adjustments. As one of the top psychiatrists in gurgaon and Delhi, we were able to determine and put some modalities to test their efficiency in treating depression. Let us take a look at the ones that prove to be most beneficial in the long run-

  • – Cognitive Behavioral Therapy- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy is one of the most versatile and efficient therapies of all. It can be applied in a variety of manners with different renditions to tackle different types of mental health conditions. It basically targets the cognition and thought patterns that pertain around a situation, and the behavior that becomes of it. The psychiatrist guides the person towards an insight, helps them understand their cognitive patterns and change them in a systematic manner to alter the maladaptive behavior. Simply speaking, the thoughts that affect behavior are altered to bring about a meaningful change. According to the psychiatrists in Delhi, it is the right therapy in many ways to tackle cases of depression.
  • – Interpersonal Therapy- This therapy involves understanding the delicate interplay of emotions that one experiences while establishing interpersonal relationships. There are many situations with our environment that can lead us to experience this, and it is seen to be highly efficient for cases with major depressive disorder. The therapy is targeted towards improving the interpersonal relationships in our life that directly affect our mood states and hence our emotions in the long run. The person is equipped with skills to understand and improve their interpersonal relationships and feed the cycle to achieve success in their communications.
  • – Mindfulness based cognitive Therapy- Known for its highly positive results in treating major depressive disorder, it was originally developed for people who experienced relapses in their depressive episodes. Mindfulness based techniques are used for the clients to help them be present in the moment, identify the issues they are dealing with and break the unhelpful patterns of thinking that pose an issue to the mental wellbeing. This typically lasts for 6-8 weeks, where the differentiating factor of accommodating a holistic modality makes it one of the best therapies for depression.

Medicative Treatments for Depression

It is a highly recognized way of treating depression with immediate effects, but it is applied upon the discretion of the psychiatrist. According to Dr. Gorav Gupta who is one of the best psychiatrists in Delhi, treatment with medications will only prove effective when combined with therapies as well as holistic recovery methods. Some of the best medications for depression include-

  • – Selective Serotonin Reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs)
  • – Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitors (MAOIs)
  • – Selective Norepinephrine Reuptake Inhibitors (SNRIs)
  • – GABA-A receptor positive modulators
  • – Tricyclic and tetracyclic antidepressants
  • – Atypical antidepressants

These medications are prescribed upon the desired modulation doses and exhibited symptoms which are decided by the healthcare professional.

How to Approach Treatment on a Personal Note

It is truly essential to understand the importance of personal efforts to aid treatment. We at Tulasi healthcare can help you strategize and build a treatment plan, but only if there are efforts to transform oneself and imagine a positive life prevail from the client’s end. Some useful tips one can easily apply in their lives to produce a transforming change include-

  • – Staying active, indulging in activities of personal interest and finding the positivity in it
  • – Adjustment of sleep wake cycle (circadian rhythm)
  • – Avoiding addictive substances like alcohol and caffeine
  • – Journaling to address issues and actively visualizing them
  • – Focusing on the present and accepting the facts that come along with it.

With these simple activities, you can bring a powerful yet extensive change in your lifestyle, which is essential for treating depression in the long run.

Find the right treatment for depression with the best psychiatrist in Delhi

Identifying the right institution to trust when it comes to your health is never an easy task- it takes a lot of thought. With our facility in your service, we can assure you that every individual receives the best care that can be. Your mental and physical well being resides with us- and we take that responsibility with pride and care. To know how you can battle depression with our help- visit Tulasi healthcare best mental hospital in Gurgaon today.

excerpt: Erectile dysfunction can be a difficult topic to talk about for many, but it is an issue that is often the center of many sexual issues and disorders. contentHtml:
Erectile dysfunction can be a difficult topic to talk about for many, but it is an issue that is often the center of many sexual issues and disorders. With many taboos surrounding it, the hush-hush cards that are played around it often exaggerate the problem to the point of no return. To tackle this, information is essential for the person who encounters this problem to ensure that they take necessary steps to move past it.

If you are looking this up and typing ‘erectile dysfunction doctors near me’ in your search bar, this is the right blog to stumble upon. With the guidance of Dr. Gorav Gupta, you will be able to understand the intensity of your condition and analyze the future course of action too.

Let’s take a look at some crucial information about knowing what erectile dysfunction is, how it may encroach on your life and what treatment options you can pursue to deal with it.

Erectile Dysfunction: What Does It Mean?

Erectile dysfunction is a type of sexual disorder where the male is unable to maintain an erection firm enough to engage in sexual intercourse. If this situation persists for more than 50% of the time, then it can be confirmed diagnostically. The emotional and physical mindset is necessary to stay aroused and erect during intercourse, so there is a complex interplay of many factors.

Such a situation can occur if you feel repulsive, nervous, anxious or tired. If you feel that it is a regular occurrence in your sexual history without any unexplained cause, it might be a good idea to search for an ‘erectile dysfunction doctor near me’ and get a consultation.

Otherwise known as impotence, this issue may be the start of a further complicated issue or an underlying problem.

In What Ways Can Erectile Dysfunction Manifest?

It can manifest in 4 different ways that are commonly observed.

Vascular ED– The most common type of ED, it affects the blood vessels that supply blood to the muscles of the penis that are responsible for holding the erection.

  • Neurogenic ED– An issue erupts in the signals supplied to the nerves of the penis to hold the erection. This can be due to many reasons- side effects of pelvic surgery, trauma, stroke, radiation therapy or multiple sclerosis.

Hormonal ED– A result of testosterone deficiency and thyroid problems, this type of erectile dysfunction can be regulated with a series of medications and control measures.

Psychogenic ED– This is usually caused by stressful conditions that generate malfunctioning thoughts and behaviors.

At What Age Does Erectile Dysfunction Manifest?

It can be at any age after puberty as a result of substance abuse or trauma, but most cases of ED are usually noted in the ages of 40-70 year old males. It affects over 50% people in the population that identify as male and this number may be higher. The taboo, embarrassment and guilt that surrounds the problem brings a hesitance in people to seek help and discuss such problems.

What are the Symptoms to look for and Causes to Uncover?

There can be an array of symptoms that can manifest to point towards erectile dysfunction. These may include-

  • -Only sometimes being able to get an erection during intercourse
  • -Struggling to maintain the erection and completing intercourse
  • -Unable to get an erection under any arousal
  • -Requiring a heightened level of stimulation to maintain erection

The causes can be related to a variety of issues that can stem from 3 major systems in the body.

  • -Circulatory system
  • -Nervous system
  • -Endocrine system

These 3 systems are the main causes of manifesting ED in the body due to physical causes. Apart from this, psychological issues can also manifest this problem.

Treatment Options and Methods for Erectile Dysfunction

If you have read until this point, you must be determined and willing to find a way to make things right. Therefore, your search for an ‘erectile dysfunction doctor near me’ ends here. Now, we can discuss some ways with which a person can successfully manage their ED and lead a healthy and successful sexual life.

  • Psychotherapy– If the underlying cause is psychogenic, then a rigorous course of psychotherapy is essential to rectify the issue. Here, the person can identify their feelings and thoughts related to their sexual behavior and identity and understand the issue that has been revolving around them. Apart from this, any repressed trauma, abuse or needs can also be identified that may be the root cause of the issue.
  • Couples counseling– It is not necessary that the problem lies within the male partner- some conflicts or uncooperative behavior on the end of the other partner may also be responsible for this outcome. To understand this perspective, one can approach couples counseling and resolve any underlying problems or undiscussed perspectives.
  • Medication therapy– Medication therapy is highly effective in cases of erectile dysfunction, coupled with continuous therapeutic interventions. Your sexologist in gurgaon or healthcare provider can help you with medications that can help you achieve an erection easily and maintain it during the period of intimacy.
  • Relaxation strategies– Relaxation strategies can help minimize the depressive, anxious and stressful effects of the situations or fear of intimacy. Meditation, mindfulness exercises, yogic exercises and visualization techniques can help manage these issues with ease and build up a successful sexual life.

Proper testing and follow up with immediate management strategies can be very helpful in providing a full recovery in this condition.

It is not easy to talk about issues that lie within the spectrum of sexual health, but with our experts at Tulasi, you will be able to open up in the comfort of our environment and establish a trustworthy relationship. Doing so will only help you move forward and beyond the dilemma of sharing and the taboo of societal judgment. Come to Tulasi healthcare and experience a space of support and comfort. title: Harmful effects of alcohol addiction: Why consider an alcohol rehabilitation center?
h1: Harmful effects of alcohol addiction: Why consider an alcohol rehabilitation center?
excerpt: If you have ever tried alcohol, chances are that you were tempted to try it again and again.Some of us can control that urge, while some of us have a hard time understanding that we are falling into a trap- a trap called addiction. There are lakhs of people in our country- that come from every […]
contentHtml:
If you have ever tried alcohol, chances are that you were tempted to try it again and again.

Some of us can control that urge, while some of us have a hard time understanding that we are falling into a trap- a trap called addiction.

There are lakhs of people in our country- that come from every type of socioeconomic status and culture who suffer from the issue of alcohol abuse. This converts into addiction over time. Only some of these people are actually aware about its fatal repercussions and approach an alcohol rehabilitation center for help.

While this issue kicks in over time, there are some long term and short term effects that can easily be observed to know that alcohol is taking a toll on their life.

Long term problems of Alcohol Addiction

There are some long term effects that can prompt you to analyze your loved one’s condition and consider an alcohol rehabilitation.

  • Heavy changes in mood, including anxiety and irritability
  • Sleep issues like insomnia and hypersomnia
  • Addiction to risky and unhinged behavior
  • Extreme changes in weight and appetite
  • Issues with concentration and memory
  • Difficulty carrying out tasks
  • Problems in keeping social, occupational and emotional commitments
  • Increased interpersonal tensions and conflicts with loved ones
  • Reduced functioning
  • Disinterest in usual hobbies and work
  • Weakened immune system

If you happen to notice even half of these issues with your loved ones, it might be time to consider talking to an expert and approaching an alcohol rehab for help.

Harmful effects of alcohol on the body

  • Digestive inflammation- People who have been consuming alcohol for long periods of time experience inflammation of the endocrine glands. This can cause pancreatitis and result in abdominal pain. It is one of the serious complications for which alcohol addiction treatment is a necessity.
  • Damage from inflammation- Our liver is responsible for breaking down the toxins in the body, which includes alcohol as well. Regular and long term consumption leads to disruption of this process and can also cause chronic liver inflammation. This inflammation is responsible for liver cirrhosis, or scarring. This results in permanently damaging the liver.
  • Sugar level fluctuations- Since the pancreas gets damaged due to excess consumption of alcohol, it can result in high insulin secretion, leading to hypoglycemia (low blood sugar). On the other hand, if the pancreas is not regulated, it can also produce a low level or no insulin at all, causing hypoglycemia (high blood sugar). This in long term develops into diabetes, and addiction treatment for such clients also becomes difficult due to bodily limitations.
  • CNS damage- One of the most damaging aspects of alcohol in the long run is its damage to the CNS. Numbness and tingling in your hands and feet is just the start of this damage. It can also affect one’s ability to form memories, perform rational thinking, and regulate one’s emotions in certain situations. It can also damage the frontal lobe of the brain responsible for higher order functioning and decision making.
  • Circulatory system complications- The heart and lungs bear the most damage when it comes to assessing problems from alcohol addiction. This is why many alcohol treatment centers perform an in depth assessment on their clients. This helps them know their limitations during treatment and customize their plans. As an alcohol de addiction center, Tulasi healthcare understands the critical issues that come with conditions like alcohol addiction.

The complications in circulatory system include-

  • High blood pressure
  • Arrhythmia
  • Heart attack
  • Heart failure
  • Stroke
  • Anemia
  • Immune system- A weakened immune system is natural when the body consumes toxins like alcohol for long periods of time. Pneumonia and tuberculosis are the first things to develop in people who are regular long time users of alcohol. According to the WHO, almost 8.1% cases of tuberculosis worldwide are a result of incessant alcohol consumption. There are many types of cancers like mouth, liver, stomach, esophagus, throat, breast, colon etc. that can develop as a result of alcohol addiction.
  • Psychological effects- Along with physical issues, the person certainly feels many psychological problems as well when battling alcohol abuse. During addiction treatment, there are many psychological hurdles they have to face in order to snap out from the trance of such an intoxicating substance. These challenges include-
  • Problems controlling impulses
  • Personality and attitude shift
  • Emotional outbursts and mental burnout.

Along with these, there are many disorders that develop as a result of excessive  alcohol consumption. These include-

  • Bipolar disorder
  • Psychotic disorder
  • Sleep disorder
  • Depressive disorder
  • Anxiety and depressive disorders

Alcohol addiction treatment: How to handle the situation?

Treatment for alcohol addiction is based upon a number of physical and psychological factors that are taken into account once you enroll into a rehabilitation center for alcohol.

Some of the treatment modalities that we employ at our facility include-

  • Detox and withdrawal- Detoxification is a physically managed program, which is necessary to flush out all the toxins from the body. It is a very crucial step in applying an alcohol addiction treatment plan. It takes about 2-7 days to property detoxify, given that there are no physical and psychological issues that should be taken into account.
  • Psychological counseling- Counseling provides an outlet for the client to understand the root cause of their issue and work upon them on an individual level. This in turn reduces the maladaptive behavior and pushes the person towards a proper transformation.
  • Holistic treatment and support strategies- A rehab center is not just about detoxifying and managing symptoms- it is also about understanding what led the person to this present moment and how they can improve their lives. At Tulasi healthcare, we employ the best holistic and support strategies so that the clients will be able to develop themselves into their best version and live a prosperous lifestyle.

Looking for the best alcohol de addiction center? Your search ends here.

Treading the steps to well being is not easy, and that too when you struggle with problems like alcohol addiction. At Tulasi healthcare, we make sure that our clients receive the best care that they need, and that too in a personalized manner from best psychiatrist in delhi. To know more how we can help you transform your lives for the best, connect with us at www.tulasihealthcare.com today.
