title: Borderline Personality Disorder: Treatment Modalities For Recovery
h1: What is Borderline Personality Disorder ? What Entails It?
excerpt: What is Borderline Personality Disorder ? What Entails It? Borderline personality– a term often used and substituted for many simple conditions, but holds many complex phenomena.It is a mental health condition where people often feel unstable about their ideas and life. They are highly indecisive, always feeling the rush of instability and intense relationships that […]
contentHtml:
Borderline personality– a term often used and substituted for many simple conditions, but holds many complex phenomena.

It is a mental health condition where people often feel unstable about their ideas and life. They are highly indecisive, always feeling the rush of instability and intense relationships that takes a toll on their overall functioning. With a strong fear of abandonment, their decision making abilities are below par. Even with their abandonment issues, they can have loving relationships which may be hindered by their anger and mood swings.

BPD personality disorder is usually diagnosed in early adulthood, with its onset from adolescence. The symptoms that it exhibits are clear markers of typical adolescent behavior, but the affected people always experience its extreme form.

If you or your loved ones are seeking help to understand borderline personality disorder and ways to find the right treatment, Tulasi’s Healthcare programs are your answer.

Borderline Personality Disorder Symptoms

The symptoms of bpd entail a wide variety of symptoms, that can be summarized as follows-

  • -Feelings of fear of abandonment and ignorance, which are quite fierce and extreme in nature
  • -A pattern of unstable beliefs about the relationship- relying on them for one moment and denying the association and attraction the next one.
  • -Instant changes in perception about self.
  • -Prolonged periods of detachment with reality and stress related paranoia.These may last from few minutes to hours, or even days.
  • -Impulsive decisions and sudden shifts to risky behaviors that sabotage safety and positive aspects of their lives.
  • -Engaging in behavior of self harm and self sabotaging
  • -Feelings of anger and emptiness

Causes and Risk Factors- Crucial Aspects

Since the causal factors for borderline personality disorder are not known, there are majorly two factors that play a part in its development. These include-

  • Genetics- Family history plays a crucial role in onset of BPD. When immediate family members suffer from BPD, the chances to develop the problem by an individual increases by a multifold.
  • Changes in brain chemistry- Research has shown that imbalance in certain neurotransmitters and disturbances in areas related to emotions and aggression play a strong part in onset of BPD along with situational factors.

Risk factors are also a key information source when it comes to understanding the root of mental health conditions. For BPD personality disorders, these risk factors include-

  • Hereditary predisposition– If a blood relative already suffers from the same condition, the chances to develop BPD are higher.
  • Stressful environment- The inability to cope with stressful situations can cause emotions to pent up. Abuse, regressive trauma and neglect in growing years can trigger the onset of BPD. Substance use due to stress can also become a triggering factor that constitutes the criteria for dual diagnosis.

Borderline Personality Disorder Treatment: Therapies To Consider

Since every individual is different in their own approach and problems, the treatment methods need to be identified in such a manner that they suit the comfort and exact needs of the client as well. With the help of an expert panel at Tulasi Healthcare, we determine the best modalities that can benefit the client the most within a short span and also sustain its effects in the long run. With this in mind some modalities that are highly coveted for the treatment of personality disorders include-

  • Cognitive Behavioral Therapy– This form of therapeutic management keeps focus on the fact that one can work on changing their cognitive patterns via insight and change the behavioral aspects of their personality. The core focus is on identifying the negative thought patterns and working on them to produce a positive behavior trail. This practice distorts negative beliefs and makes the person more aware of their actions.
  • Dialectical behavior therapy– DBT uses a skill based approach. It teaches the client skills that help them manage aggravating emotions, identify their patterns and deal with them in a real life setting. This is why it is the most commonly referred therapy for BPD. Tolerating negative emotions can be a highly demanding task, but DBT being an emotion focused therapeutic modality handles this aspect very well.
  • Medication based treatment– Along with the therapeutic treatment plans, some clients may require a medical intervention to control the intensity and frequency of their symptoms. Antidepressant and anti-anxiety medications can be a source of relief and management. Depending upon the issues faced, the expert in consultation can suggest appropriate dosages and time period for which the medication can be administered. Tulasi Healthcare has best team of psychiatrist in delhi & gurgaon for the treatment. 
  • Holistic therapies– Holistic therapy is a wonderful addition to any disorder, especially when it comes to mental health. Holistic methods like yoga, mindfulness and meditation are some evidence based modalities that have proven their efficacy over a large population. Since they have a strong effect in changing the mood states and maintaining them, they are a common part of treatment at Tulasi Health Care.

Still Looking For ‘Best Borderline Personality Disorder Treatment Near Me’? Visit Our Facility

Surrounding oneself with people we can trust and count on factors in as a major part of approaching treatment. At Tulasi Healthcare, you will feel the air of connection and concern as soon as you meet with one of our experts. Guidance and education on mental health treatment should never be a taboo, and our experts make sure of that. With one of the best rehabilitation centers in Delhi, we will be happy to host you and help you find the solution for your mental health concerns.

Diagnostic Modalities For Borderline Personality Disorder

Borderline Personality Disorder diagnosis can be a highly complicated task, since the symptoms clash with many disorders that can be misinterpreted combined with other situational and contributing factors.

It is also important to note that the children may bear the brunt of this condition more since the symptoms can clash with the normal and expected beliefs of adolescence- leading to a late intervention.

Mental health evaluation with the help of an expert is the right way to approach its diagnosis and treatment. Sometimes, the problem can come with a dual diagnosis which may complicate the treatment as well as the diagnosis procedure.

title: Dealing With Borderline Personality Disorder : Case Study With Management Strategies
h1: Dealing With Borderline Personality Disorder : Case Study With Management Strategies
excerpt: Borderline personality disorder is a condition where the person’s behaviors, thoughts and actions are not aligned and pose an issue for their daily functioning and occupational efficiency. Today, we discuss X’s case, that will enlighten us on another aspect of BPD as a psychological condition and how it can be managed using expert interventions and […]
contentHtml:
Borderline personality disorder is a condition where the person’s behaviors, thoughts and actions are not aligned and pose an issue for their daily functioning and occupational efficiency.

Today, we discuss X’s case, that will enlighten us on another aspect of BPD as a psychological condition and how it can be managed using expert interventions and techniques.

Today’s case is about X, who is a 31 year old female who has separated from her husband. She belongs to a middle socio-economic status family and is currently unemployed.

The case was brought to our attention by her father and brother, and an adequate personal and family history was obtained.

The duration of her illness and symptoms was reported to be from the last 15 years, for which she had prior consultations, but with no improvements due to discontinuation of treatment on the client’s part. The problem aggravated in the last 2-3 years with-

Mode of onset- Insidious

Course- Continuous

Progress- Deteriorating

Predisposing factor-  Family history of Bipolar Affective Disorder in grandfather and brother and depression in sister.

Perpetuating factor- Interpersonal conflicts in family and expressed emotions

Precipitating factor- Nil

X’s Journey of Mindful Transformation

X had a difficult journey of 15 years with the issue of borderline personality disorder, and could not realize the root cause behind it. When she visited a psychiatrist, she was prescribed-

  • Zenoxa tab
  • Olimelt tab and
  • Etilaam tab

She only consumed the medicines for 5 days, before discontinuing the process. As her condition was already deteriorating, this was aggravated by a sudden discontinuation.

After this, she visited Tulasi health care for an in-depth consultation from one of the best psychiatrists in Delhi, and her transformation was a spectacle to behold.

History of Present Illness

  • -The client’s history clearly dictated their problem’s onset. From the age of 16 years, she experienced mood fluctuations and a demanding behavior. On top of this, as this was adolescent period, it was taken as a passing symptom and ignored.
  • -Over the next 2-3 years, she became highly defiant towards her parents, as she had progressed towards her engineering degree.
  • -She found herself extremely irritable, angry and restless during this period.
  • -X felt she was disconnected from self and others, which disrupted her functionality.
  • -She reported being lonely, which was often short lived. Which was compensated with an indulging of shopping and baseless roaming.
  • -Her dynamics with her family were very turbulent and unstable.
  • -X’s financial dynamics were also very indecisive, where she would overspend and had also taken a huge loan which was spent on luxury goods and items that were not needed.
  • -X also had a history with substance abuse (tobacco and cannabis), during her college time.This behavior continued till and after she was married.
  • -Due to dwindling relations with her in-laws, she separated from her husband within 3 months of marriage
  • -During this time, she also changed over 8-9 jobs in a span of 6.5 years. She felt dissatisfied one day and motivated the other.
  • -All the mentioned disturbances led her to partake in the BPD management plan under the experts of Tulasi healthcare.

Mental Status Examination

Appearance- Thin built, looks younger than stated age, well kept.

Awareness- Conscious

Cooperated with the experts

Oriented to time, place and person

Felt anxious and restless

Rapport- easily established

Psychomotor activity- increased

Speech- Relevant, audible and normal rate, tone and volume. Spontaneous, coherent and goal directed

Mood and affect- subjectively she did not feel fine. Objectively she felt anxious and raged.

Reactivity- decreased and restricted to anxious pole

Attention- aroused and sustained

Memory- recent and remote memory were adequate.

Insight- partial, attributes behavioral changes to external factors

Chief Complaints

  • -Excessive mood swings and irritable at all times
  • -Enraged quite easily
  • -Interpersonal relations with friends and family are unstable
  • -Feels lonely and fears being alone
  • -Disturbed routine
  • -Failure to concentrate, form goals and aspirations
  • -Inability to understand emotions and commit to any task

Diagnostic Formulation

With an insight level of grad 3, X was diagnosed with Emotionally Unstable Personality disorder according to the ICD-11 criterion.

The points that dictate this diagnosis include-

  • -Unstable and interpersonal relationships
  • -Impulsive spending and substance consumption
  • -Affective instability
  • -Chronic feeling of emptiness
  • -Explosive anger episodes
  • -Feelings of abandonment
  • -Identity disturbance- unstable self image

Assessment Tools and Criteria

X was tackled with various assessment tools to confirm her diagnosis and supporting symptoms.

The assessments included-

  • Sack’s Sentence Completion test (SSCT)
  • Million Clinical Multiaxial Inventory 3 (MCMI-3)
  • Her scores on the tests indicated towards borderline personality disorder, which indicats that she experiences intense endogenous moods with recurring periods of dejection and apathy often interspered spells od irritability.

Management Strategies Applied : Specialized For Various Domains

The management routine was highly specialized, given that the client faced the condition for more than 15 years and needed interventions that provided immediate relief to her.

The strategies included-

  • Activity scheduling– Since the client faced problems in concentrating and making goals, activity scheduling was an appropriate option. Cognitive remediation training to improve attention and concentration, recreational, yoga and indoor sports.
  • Psychoeducation– Education regarding harmful effects of substances, NA literature, discussions and addiction group sessions were organized.
  • Dialectical Behvaioral Therapy- Mindfulness, interpersonal effectiveness, distress tolerance and emotional regulation.
  • Family therapy– This identified the communication barriers, and balanced out the disturbed family dynamics as well. She was encouraged to travel her hometown and take part in family celebrations to enhance her feelings of belongingness.
  • Financial responsibility– Finacial indecisiveness was a major part of her jounrey, and this was tackled with education on financial targeting, and keeping track of expenditure. This exercise helped in maintaing her goals.

Conclusion

With some of the best psychiatrists in Delhi, X’s recovery was a spectacle to behold. It was possible due to the keen observation and personalized attention that she received which translated into a transformational journey of a life time for X. Her condition improved drastically and she felt that she was starting her life anew.

If you want your loved ones to live a life that is healthy and mentally well, don’t hestaitate to connect with us today.

My family will take better care of me at home, what will a de-addiction center do for me?

With this in mind, we discuss the benefits of enrolling in a deaddiction center and how the planned structure brings a drastic difference in the lives of people with addiction issues.

How does an addiction treatment center alter the mindset of addicted people?

What is so different about a facility that cannot be replicated at home and applied there?

Let’s dive deep into it.

  • A Safe Environment For Recovery: Recovery takes an immense amount of peace and security. When an individual feels safe and secure, they can take on a task that requires their strength and morale. Providing a positive environment is necessary to foster a good start to the journey of de addiction. While interacting with families of addicted individuals, their primary concern is safety as well. So, at Tulasi healthcare, we take necessary measures to provide an environment that builds a base to the best healthcare facilities.
  • Strong Support System: An inpatient facility has the highest level of support system that is available at any hour of the day. Clinical supervision alongwith counseling support is a must, given that the psychological condition of people undergoing the de-addiction process is quite challenging. During this time, the body and the mind tries to readjust to the process of de addiction, where the individual faces drastic changes that cannot be handled without proper support. Even with family intervention, the person will require expert assistance to guide them during this difficult time. This is where a drug de addiction center fulfills its purpose.

Setting Goals And Building Healthy Habits: This is something that is not possible at home- the comfort and the lack of routine inhibits a person to take their deaddiction journey seriously.

If you hop on to any search bar and type ‘ de addiction center near me’, the first thing you will find is the inclusion of routine setting and making goals that benefit an individual.

With Tulasi Healthcare, these promises are not only verbal, but also applied to their most practical form. A drug de addiction center can teach you to categorize your short and long term recovery goals and build healthy habits that facilitate them in the long run.

  • Behavioral Transformation: Behavioral transformation is a huge part of recovery. When a person gets addicted, their personality and behavior takes a huge hit. Their priorities and actions change, resulting in maladaptive behaviors and reckless decision making. A de addiction center is a place of transformation that induces a real change in a person’s behavior, that is scientifically backed and shows powerful results.  This is something that is not possible in the vicinity of a home, within the walls of comfort and surrounded by familiar company.
  • Expert Therapeutic Treatment: Addiction is a disease that affects a person physically and psychologically. This means that without expert intervention, there is a high likelihood that their condition will worsen. When a person approaches a drug de addiction center or a alcohol de addiction center for managing their problem, they sign up for the surroundings, positivity and the expert help that is essential for them to gain insight.

Effective therapeutic measures can restore a person’s insight, leading to restoration of their health and mindset. Relapse is also a possibility that many consider, for which additional resources and steps are taken at the end of the de-addiction center. Some evidence based de-addiction therapies that are actively included in the treatment plan at Tulasi healthcare include-

  • Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
  • Contingency management
  • Family therapy
  • Dialectical Behavioral Therapy (DBT)
  • Eye Movement desensitization and Reprocessing therapy (EMDR)
  • Rational Emotive Behavioral Therapy (REBT)

These treatment measures are customized according to the client’s condition, given that they are responding well and showing significant improvement along the way.

  • Health Focused Care: De-addiction centers are not just focused on removing the acquired substances from the client’s system. The whole premise of pursuing a treatment program is because of its holistic nature. When the person starts using a substance, their body loses out on lots of nutrients that can develop many health related issues. To combat this, facilities have a team of expert nutritionists and diet experts on board to advise and build a personal nutrition regimen for each person according to the condition they are suffering from.

Many studies have proven  that people in recovery gain the best nutritional value from a low-glycemic, dopamine-boosting diet. This is because it has the most protein sources, foods that are rich in fiber, and unsaturated fats.

How Do I Connect With The Best De Addiction Center Near Me?

It is not easy to cover the journey to recovery alone. Having experts that have the experience and conscience to help you is necessary. With Tulasi healthcare as your option, you explore multiple facilities under one roof and insights from multiple experts that work in unity to bring you back to your best self. To know how you can start your deaddiction journey, connect with us today or visit our facility.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

FAQs

What is a de addiction center?

A de addiction center is a facility where a person can enroll themselves and pursue expert treatment for conditions like drug addiction, alcohol addiction and other addictive substances. Psychotherapeutic and medical treatment are combined to build a treatment plan for the clients.

Why should one go to a de-addiction center?

When a person faces problems in their daily life due to consumption of addictive substances, one should visit a de-addiction center. At such facilities, experts like psychiatrists and psychologists along with many experts are present to assess your issues and make a treatment plan according to your condition.

What is a deaddiction therapy procedure?

A person is first assessed, diagnosed and then recommended for a detoxification process. With this regime, a holistic mix of therapies, medications and nutrition is applied to increase the recovery rate of the individual.

contentHtml:
The presence of utterly intrusive thoughts and obsessions in a person’s life that leads to maladaptive behaviors and problems adjusting in daily life activities is recognized as Obsessive Compulsive Disorders.

These problems have an abrupt onset, with no explorable cause during its early intervention. To explore the details involved, we share a case study today so our readers can explore and learn about the disorder from a real time situation.

Case study: SJ’s journey of transformation

Explore SJ’s journey with us, alias for a 31 year old male, who approached Tulasi Healthcare with primary reported symptoms of persistent anxiety, intrusive thoughts and compulsive behaviors that were present for a span of 8 years (2012-2020) and constantly escalating since then. His case file is a testament of our persistence in finding the root cause of your issues and providing a holistic solution to it.

Initial Assessment

As per the details, the client belonged to a middle socio economic status, unmarried and was a doctor by profession. The symptoms stated were rendering him unable to focus on his tasks as a caregiver. The daily functioning and quality of life were deteriorating at a steep pace.

The client had no reported history of psychiatric illnesses in the family, and the presenting problems were persistent since the last decade.

  • Mental status Examination– The client kept a tidy appearance and was aware of his surroundings. Maintaining eye contact was seen as a struggle for the client. He was quite cooperative during the whole process. With increased psychomotor activity, he maintained a good rapport.

-Speech Audible, responded properly to questions

-Reaction time recorded was normal

-Had an adequate productivity, coherent and goals directed relay of thoughts

-The tone and pitch of his voice was normal and within range

-Thought content reflected fears of dirt and contamination.

-No perceptual disturbances were present

-Judgment was intact

-Insight level- Grade 3

Reported Symptoms– Chief complaints included persistent anxiety, intrusive thoughts and compulsive behaviors.

Obsessive symptoms– these involved concerns relating to waste and secretions, dirt and contamination, persistent doubts regarding right and wrong, morality, lucky and unlucky numbers.

Compulsive symptoms– Repeated checking of locks, geyser, switches and other electronic devices. The client used to inspect the clothes before wearing, check the chairs before sitting. Had ritualized showering and tooth brushing.

-The rituals were acquiring a lot of productive time, which caused his daily functioning to be hampered.

-His overall productivity at work declined

-He constantly withdrew from social interactions and avoided gatherings and public places in fears of contracting a contamination

  • -Felt embarrassed because of his compulsions
  • -His interpersonal relations were also affected severely as he would not communicate properly and avoid calls

Development of Treatment Plan: A personalized approach

Now that SJ’s condition is properly assessed and identified, building a treatment plan will be easy and informed. With our team of experts specializing in various formats of therapy, we designed a comprehensive care approach for SJ.

Let’s take a look at the treatment plan-

Brief component breakup-

  • Counseling sessions– The counseling sessions consisted of therapeutic interventions that focused on changing the thought process and patterns related to OCD treatment, and specific therapies like CBT and ECT were applied in SJ’s case.

Brain Stimulation Techniques– Since SJ was facing this issue for more than a decade, introducing brain stimulation techniques was deemed necessary to get rid of the issue from the root.

Holistic management plan– Holistic activities like yoga and mindfulness were also prescribed to put an emphasis on positive and present thoughts, This helped the client become aware of their thought flow and ways to manage it.

Cognitive Behavioral Therapy– This modality here was mainly focused on controlling SJ’s activities and scheduling. Our therapist asked him to prepare a daily ritual record that helped him gain insight into his patterns and work upon them. Psychoeducation was also provided to make them aware of the expected challenges during OCD treatment. A proper obsession, compulsion and anxiety graph was drawn out to explain the length of an OCD cycle and help SJ manage through these ebbs and flows.

Exposure and Response Prevention– This involved exposing SJ to different situations that entice a response because of his obsessions and prevented him from engaging in corresponding compulsions. SJ was also made aware about cognitive distortions, which were eventually challenged and managed through cognitive restructuring.

Deep Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation– Since the symptoms persisted for a longer period of time, the client was suggested to take 30 sessions of dTMS, which targets specific parts of the brain that are responsible for onset of OCD. SJs condition improved dramatically over the course of 30 sessions.

Path to recovery: Challenges and Coping

Recovery is not always an easy task. SJ faced his fair share of challenges, but our staff at Tulasi healthcare were supportive and understanding at every step of his journey. With care, compassion and patience, SJ was able to cope with his treatment in a matter of a few weeks.

Initially, he faced issues in understanding the goals of his therapy and actually coping with the mechanisms that were discussed. But afterwards, the small steps of encouragement and gradual growth led to a transformational change in his condition.

Transition to aftercare

SJ has slowly transitioned to aftercare planning, where he is doing well with the resources provided and joining group sessions where he can cope and address any further problems he faces.

Final Thoughts on SJ’s condition

Overall, SJ showed gradual improvement and reported reduced frequency of his compulsions. He especially felt a drastic change with ERP and dTMS treatment. His anxiety levels decreased and began to re-engage in activities he had previously avoided.

Conclusion

Through this case, we project that we as caregivers highly prioritize your health and well-being, taking every aspect of your life into consideration. As one of the best psychiatric hospitals in Delhi, we believe in providing the best of care and support to our clients.

We hope this case gives you an insight into your issues and prompts you to take a step towards your well being today. To know more about OCD treatment and its related issues, visit our healthcare facility today.

But, with the change in current times, our country has seen a stark shift in the level of recognition and understanding the need to address mental health conditions. After a significant budget allocation to mental health, India has seen a rise in the development of mental health policies and institutions to aid as many people as possible that suffer in silence or are far from knowing what ails them.

Today, we discover the 5 best mental hospitals in India while knowing about their significance. h1: The Journey of a Mental Health Patient: A Case Study at Tulasi Healthcare
excerpt: Welcome to the Tulasi Healthcare blog, and to our most important share with you today: a touching, enlightened case study on a journey by a mental health patient through a mental health hospital. contentHtml:
Welcome to the Tulasi Healthcare blog, and to our most important share with you today: a touching, enlightened case study on a journey by a mental health patient through a mental health hospital. We do so in the hopes of shining a light ray onto this very misunderstood world called mental health care, while highlighting the caring and life-changing work being done here at Tulasi Healthcare.

What is Mental Health, and what is the importance of a Mental Health Hospital?

Though as crippling and life-altering as physical illness, mental illnesses suffer from stigma and misconception. In a mental health hospital or a mind hospital, one is reassured that treatment would take place with respect to the requirements of each case. Making this journey taken with support and care is the goal at Tulasi Healthcare.

Case Story: Ananya's Journey

Walk with Ananya, alias for a 32-year-old lady who reached out to Tulasi Healthcare for support with severe anxiety and depression. Her case stands as a testimonial of how holistic our approach is in treating mental health.

1. Initial Assessment: Understanding the Whole Person

Ananya’s treatment journey began with a proper initial assessment. The mental and emotional status, as far as it was concerned, was done in detail by the mental health team: psychiatrists, psychologists, and psychiatric nurses. However, this first step was not for diagnosis purposes but more about how she had been leading her life and her personal background that caused her mental health struggles.

Establishing rapport means between Ananya and her care team, a relationship of trust will be built. Individualization of treatment plans shall be done for her.

2. Development of the Treatment Plan : Collaboration and Tailor-Making

Now that the condition of Ananya had been assessed, it was time to chalk out a treatment plan. This had to be decided mutually by Ananya and her care team. We, at Tulasi Healthcare, believe in the philosophy of patient-centered care—making the patient a part of the treatment process.

Components of Treatment

Counseling sessions: She commenced attending the therapy sessions by the licensed psychologist. This provided her with a platform where she could talk freely and express without any inhibitions.

Medical management: Ananya visited a psychiatrist who started her on medication to manage anxiety and depression. Regular follow-ups ensured that she was getting better and the medicines were working, hence adjustment as per requirement.

Supportive Activities: Group therapy, mindfulness practices, and creative workshops have been initiated to aid Ananya in connecting with others and finding new ways of coping.

3. Recovery Process: Challenges and Triumphs

Recovery isn’t always in a straight line. Of course, setbacks and breakthroughs are part of what Ananya has gone through during her stay at the mental health hospital. However, through the treatment process at Tulasi Healthcare, patients are aided in every step of their journey.

Challenges Faced:

Initial Resistance: Anaya was a bit unwilling to open up with the progress of the therapy. Our team worked patiently at establishing trust and eliciting participation.

Medication Adjustments: She required rebalancing of medications, which took some time to achieve by gradual adjustments and close monitoring.

Triumphs Achieved :

Gradually Improved Mental Health: She felt an improvement in her mental health over time. According to her, with the therapy and workshops, she felt much more positive and capable of overcoming the hurdles of anxiety and depression

4. Improved Coping Skills: Through therapy and workshops

Anaya learnt new ways of coping better. This was followed by the concept of learning to manage her mental health well.

5. Transition to Aftercare: Preparing for Life Outside Hospital

This would be the preparation both mental and physical, of Ananya for life outside a mental health hospital. This shall entail making a transition plan that will support her recovery upon discharge.

Elements of Transition

Outpatient therapy: Connection with an outpatient therapist for follow-up after discharge from the hospital.

Support Systems: We connected Ananya with the support systems in place, like family, friends, and community resources.

Self-care practices: More self-care and a healthy lifestyle were recommended.

Outcomes of a Holistic Model of Mental Health

Ananya’s story across Tulasi Healthcare epitomizes what comprehensive and sensitive treatment does for mental health care. Our team at Tulasi Healthcare is deeply committed to the creation of an empathetic and safe atmosphere for patients ailing with mental disorders to recuperate and return to routine life.

Why This Matters:

Holistic Care: By attending to every single aspect of her mental and emotional wellbeing, we gave Ananya a platform for long-lasting recovery.

Patient-Centric Treatment: Empowering Ananya with responsibility for her treatment plan put her at the helm of her mental health.

Ongoing Support: The step-down from the in-patient unit to the out-patient unit was a well-thought-out way to ensure that Ananya still could get the help she needed in keeping up the gains made.

Conclusion

The journey of a mental health patient across a mental health hospital is very personal and hence, it transforms. Ananya’s is an example of great strength regarding how reflective patient-centered care can help people turn around their lives and make meaningful improvements in mental health. We at Tulasi Healthcare are proud to do this foundational work so that hope and healing could be brought into the lives of people in need.

If you or anyone else is out here fighting any trouble with regard to mental health, then do reach out. Let us at Tulasi Healthcare help you at every step of your journey in mental health. You can visit our website:  Tulasi Healthcare to know more about our services and how we can help you.

title: Best treatment modalities for Bipolar Disorder
h1: Best treatment modalities for Bipolar Disorder
excerpt: Bipolar disorder is defined as an extreme mood based spectrum that includes emotional highs and lows. These mood swings can affect the daily routine, personality, occupational and financial aspects of the ones affected. The frequency of these episodes can highly vary, and the people may feel emotional symptoms that can confuse the people around them. […]
contentHtml:
Bipolar disorder is defined as an extreme mood based spectrum that includes emotional highs and lows. These mood swings can affect the daily routine, personality, occupational and financial aspects of the ones affected. The frequency of these episodes can highly vary, and the people may feel emotional symptoms that can confuse the people around them. Once the symptoms become out of control, the people can feel it difficult to continue with their daily lives without professional intervention. If you are looking for an effective bipolar disorder treatment in Noida, read this blog to know more how you can navigate and find the correct regime for your loved ones.

Major types according to emotional front

Depending upon the major mood state that the person describes according to their symptoms, bipolar disorder can be majorly categorized into 4 major types-

  • -Bipolar 1– Occurrence of 1 episode of mania, after which it is followed by episodes of hypomania or major depression. In some cases, mania can also lead to a state of psychosis.
  • -Bipolar 2– Occurrence of one hypomanic episode followed by a major depressive episode. Here, manic episodes are absent.
  • -Cyclothymic– At Least 1-2 years of alternating periods of hypomania symptoms along with depressive symptoms (cyclic manner)
  • -Other– Categorized in bipolar and related disorders, they can be triggered by substance use or through a medical condition. Examples include Cushing’s disease, multiple sclerosis or stroke.

Symptomatology

For mania and hypomania

Mania is a more severe form of hypomania that causes significant disturbances in personal and social life. Apart from that, it can also trigger a state of psychosis. Both of these are different in their intensities but share similar symptoms. They can share any 3 or more symptoms mentioned here-

  • -Increased activity and energy
  • -Feeling unrealistically positive about everything
  • -Unusually jumpy and excited
  • -Highly talkative and restless
  • -Feels no need to sleep
  • -Highly distracted
  • -Poor decision making skills

For major depressive episode

The body and the mind of an individual affected with a major depressive episode slows down significantly. There is a marked difference in their lifestyle, social interaction and interpersonal relationships. An episode shows 5 or more symptoms mentioned below-

  • -Becoming empty, sad and hopeless about everything
  • -Turning every positive into a negative
  • -Loss of interest and pleasure in once enjoyable activities
  • -Insomnia/ hypersomnia
  • -Suicidal thoughts or motivations
  • -Feeling restless and fatigued all the time
  • -Indecisive and lack of concentration

When should one consult an expert?

-Neurodevelopmental disorders- These issues interfere with neural development and begin from infancy to childhood. Classic examples of this are ADHD (Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder), Autism Spectrum disorders and learning disorders.

–Bipolar and related disorders- It is a mood disorder that rotates on mood extremes. There can be extremely elated mood periods (energetic, active and full of happy thoughts) and depressive episodes.

–Depressive episodes– A disorder that affects the emotional moods- the level of serotonin drops drastically resulting in prolonged depressive disorders. These can include depressive disorder and premenstrual dysphoric disorder.

-Trauma and stressor related disorders- These are some of the most commonly found disorders since the root cause lies within the daily issues and common dilemmas. Coping after a stressful event can be problematic for some, leading to disorders like Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) and Acute stress disorder.

-Substance related disorders- These disorders develop due to excessive use of substances like alcohol, cocaine, heroin, marijuana etc. and are highly damaging on both physical and psychological levels. Since there is a little scope to administer medical intervention in these cases, it can be highly difficult to deal with.

–Personality disorders– A set maladaptive pattern of emotional instability that leads to unhealthy behavior and difficulty adjusting with life and relationships. Some of these issues include- narcissistic personality disorder, borderline personality disorder, antisocial personality disorder etc.

More treatments like Vagus Nerve stimulation are also in its research phases to identify its effects and target the responsible brain areas.

title: Lifestyle regimen for Alcohol Addiction
h1: Lifestyle regimen for Alcohol Addiction
excerpt: Removing alcohol addiction from the system is not only about separating from the substance itself- it is also about forming new habits and adopting a healthy lifestyle to sustain well-being. One of the major roles in this healthy lifestyle is played by nutrition and holistic activities. Without their added advantage, it is impossible to recover […]
contentHtml:
Removing alcohol addiction from the system is not only about separating from the substance itself- it is also about forming new habits and adopting a healthy lifestyle to sustain well-being. One of the major roles in this healthy lifestyle is played by nutrition and holistic activities. Without their added advantage, it is impossible to recover based solely on medication and therapies. As psychiatrist for alcohol addiction, our expert Dr. Gorav Gupta points out certain aspects of your lifestyle that are key to your transformative journey.

In today’s blog, we take a keen interest in knowing what dietary, lifestyle and holistic practices are a must to recover from alcohol addiction and decrease the risk of relapse in future.

How misuse affects your body’s nutritive points?

The brain holds the ability to restore and form new connections called neuroplasticity. With alcohol addiction, these connections are disrupted and degenerate the body’s ability to perform common cognitive functions.

Alcohol use disorder can affect your body in many different ways.

  • Appetite loss- Alcohol slows down the digestive system, and even reduces the need to eat, leading to malnourishment.
  • Less nutritious foods- Added sugar, salt and saturated fats are the foods that an alcohol user craves, leading to a choice of foods that are not good for health.
  • Hypoglycemia- Alcohol and poor eating can result in your liver releasing very less glucose in your blood and lead to low blood sugar, known as hypoglycemia. A Psychiatrist for alcohol addiction is well aware of such conditions and can manage them without any harm to your body.
  • Damage to organs- Alcohol can highly affect your organs, damaging your stomach’s inner lining, intestines, pancreas, liver and many other organs. Cirrhosis and alcoholic hepatitis along with other conditions can develop as a result.

Questions from your psychiatrist for alcohol addiction

There are certain aspects which the health care provider must know before they can build a highly compatible treatment plan with your lifestyle choices. The below listed questions may be asked and an honest answer will help you adequately plan your treatment and pursue a better lifestyle with provided suggestions.

  • How often and how much do you drink?
  • Do you have any family members who face a similar issue with alcohol?
  • Has anyone in your social or family circle suggested you curb your drinking habit?
  • Have you observed yourself drinking more and more?
  • Have you ever tried to stop? If so, did you feel any withdrawal or did you fail in your attempt to cut back?
  • Have you faced any reprimand in your social and occupational circles regarding this habit?
  • Have you ever been dangerous or harmful to others after consuming alcohol?
  • Do you have any physical problems since you have started consuming alcohol like diabetes, liver issues etc.?
  • Are you feeling any anxiety or depression?
  • Have you tried using any recreational drugs?

According to the answers that the psychiatrist receives, a team of experts will curate a lifestyle and activity plan along with the therapies and medication that will be compatible to eliminate alcohol addiction from its roots.

How can a team of experts help you?

Dietary supplements, nutrition and alternative medicine play a crucial role in restoring the body’s physical systems and building a stronger base for mental rehabilitation. As one of the best psychiatrist for alcohol addiction, Dr. Gorav Gupta and his team of rehabilitation experts (nutritionists, psychologists, social workers, psychiatric nurses, counselors) make sure that every client recovers with keen attention to every aspect. Some tips that can be followed to ensure  healthy lifestyle patterns are mentioned here-

  • Supplements- Damage to pancreas and liver can lead to nutritional imbalances in the body. Vitamin B9, Vitamin B6 and Vitamin B1 can be excellent nutritional supplements.
  • Vitamin B9- also known as folic acid, increases the level of iron in the body and reduces fatigue and tiredness.
  • Vitamin B6- Lack of this vitamin can lead to a weakened immune system, depression and anxiety symptoms.
  • Vitamin B1- Also known as thiamine, its lack can lead to severe memory problems and continued deficiency may lead to Wernicke-Korsakoff’s syndrome.

It is important to consult your doctors and nutritionists before taking any supplements as they can suggest the best course of action and compatibility with ongoing medicines.

  • Essential foods- Carbohydrates are necessary to produce serotonin, that alleviates the mood and lessens the probability of developing anxiety and depression. Amino acids help produce dopamine, that reduce mood swings and are in general responsible to maintain a positive behavior. Dietary fats are highly involved in boosting neuroplasticity along with fatty acids that boost speeds of neural transmission.
  • Holistic methods- Along with conventional therapy and medication, alternative routes are also proven to be highly effective in reducing the effects of alcohol addiction. As a highly renowned facility, we provide experts that are trained in developing every aspect of our client’s recovery journey to result in an overall restoration.
  • Yoga- Yoga has highly proven its efficiency in rejuvenating the mind and body, and contributes highly to cellular restoration.A series of personalized postures and breathing exercises can help the client manage their stress, anxiety and focus on their thoughts.
  • Meditation- Meditation is a great way of focusing on the present moment and building a mindset that will help the individual focus on finding a solution to their problem, and build a transformational life for themselves.
  • Mindfulness exercises- An unconventional strategy based on buddhist philosophy, this method has also proven its grit in managing stressful and anxious mindset to build on positive aspects of a disturbed life.

Looking for a detailed consultation? We’re here to help.

title: Interventions for treatment resistant depression
h1: Interventions for treatment resistant depression
excerpt: Treatment resistant depression can be defined in simple terms as the case where normal psychotherapy and treatment modalities fail to treat the existing condition of depression. Taking counseling and therapy eases the symptoms of depression in most cases, but certain percentage of cases might resist this treatment and continue to worsen the symptoms over time.It […]
contentHtml:
Treatment resistant depression can be defined in simple terms as the case where normal psychotherapy and treatment modalities fail to treat the existing condition of depression. Taking counseling and therapy eases the symptoms of depression in most cases, but certain percentage of cases might resist this treatment and continue to worsen the symptoms over time.

It is better to ask your health care provider to recommend you to a specialist like a psychiatrist who can study all the inter-related factors playing a part in resisting treatment and suggest a treatment plan that helps alleviate the symptoms of depression. As one of the best psychiatrists in Gurgaon, Dr. Gorav Gupta hosts a facility that has all the needed resources to deal with such treatment resistant conditions.

The psychiatrist will make sure to evaluate your history and confirm a few aspects.

  • Confirm any pressing situations that might be flaring up your symptoms
  • Evaluate your responses to treatment like medication, therapy and other treatments previously tried.
  • Review all medications to check compatibility and other non prescribed drugs as well (supplements)
  • Discuss the medication routine with the client and examine if it is being followed properly
  • Factor in other health conditions and analyze if they are restricting the treatment plan from being administered properly.
  • Consider a dual diagnosis, that will help fight rising symptoms and ease out the treatment effect.

Such cases may require repeated testing and analysis to see what approach works best for the client. At Tulasi Healthcare, we have one of the best teams of psychiatrist in Delhi and Gurgaon that are well versed in handling such cases.

Medication Adjustment and Strategies

A medication or a combination of mediations might not just suit your specific condition, and some specific adjustments can be made with suggestions from your psychiatrist. Some pointers to keep in mind are-

  • Stay on your medications to see its full effect- It sometimes takes longer for medication to fully kick in and show effects. A time period of around 6-8 weeks should be allotted before considering a change in dosage.
  • Increase/Decrease dosage- According to the body type, people may feel certain side effects or may feel no change at all. After considering intermediate factors of your condition, discuss a dosage that will suit your needs and affect your symptoms positively.
  • Changing antidepressants- Changing your course of antidepressants can be a good path of action. Several antidepressants are available in the market and not every single one of them works for everyone.
  • Consider pharmacogenetic testing- Your genetic composition also determines how well medications work on your body and what metabolism conditions affect the use of certain medications.

What to consider in case of treatment resistance?

Some additional treatment options are also available in case adjustments with therapy and medications do not work out. These facilities are available at Tulasi Health care and graced by a state of the art lab with operational experts.

  • Deep Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (dTMS)– This treatment uses magnetic stimulation to stimulate areas of the brain that are responsible for inducing depression. This method employs a coil that is attached to the scalp of the person, that induces electric current. This current stimulates the nerve cells of the targeted area. A highly sought after treatment for depression, this method is shown to produce highly positive results in combination with therapy and medications. It is a 30 minute session that is carried out with short bursts. A new advancement can help it deliver in much brief sessions with dosing called intermittent theta burst stimulation.
  • Electroconvulsive Therapy (ECT)– A rather seldom used therapy, ECT induces brief seizures when the person is in a state of unconsciousness through electrodes. This therapy induces a rather accelerated change in the brain chemistry that quickly reverts the symptoms of depression. The therapy carries some temporary side effects, but it is able to produce a drastic change in depression symptoms within a few sessions.

Looking for answers? Consult now.

It is highly recommended to understand and pursue treatment only if it works in your favor and shows a positive change. As one of the most revered psychiatrists in Gurgaon, Dr. Gorav Gupta has led and assisted on many cases of depression, each with their own intricacies and treatment plan. title: How does addiction begin?
h1: How does addiction begin?
excerpt: It is a very frequent occurrence at our facility when people ask us ‘How does addiction begin?’ The ones who are directly affected by it are not only unaware, but the way it affects them is so severe that they are unable to comprehend its issues. Asked by family members on a regular basis, we […]
contentHtml:
It is a very frequent occurrence at our facility  when people ask us ‘How does addiction begin?’

The ones who are directly affected by it are not only unaware, but the way it affects them is so severe that they are unable to comprehend its issues.

Asked by family members on a regular basis, we have psychoeducated many people on the topic of substance addiction. As a prominent psychiatrist in Delhi, we have encountered cases that lack any insight of the situation they are in and need constant guidance to steer clear of their maladaptive behaviors.

Every person is different, and so is their situation, habits and predispositions towards the development of an addiction. Today, we’ll discuss the beginning of an addiction journey, and how we can steer clear of them with the right intervention.

Beginning of addiction

The National Institute of drug abuse defines addiction as a chronic condition. Addiction alters the experience of pleasure and disrupts the body’s natural pleasure centers. The body seeks a higher level of stimulation every time, which results in over consumption of the substance. Every single time, the body’s need for the substance goes up, that ultimately turns to addiction.

Going into depth, the body releases dopamine which is a feel good chemical for the brain. It starts from nucleus accumbens which is the pleasure center. Dopamine here acts as a reward which motivates the system to repeat the acts and gain the same pleasure again and again.The burden on the pleasure center to seek the same level increases, thus leading to addictive behaviors.

Reasons for substance addiction

Addiction is a result of many situational factors, and continuous exposure to these factors are responsible for it. Some of these are-

  • Curiosity
  • Peer pressure
  • Dealing with difficult situations
  • Avoiding stressful situations
  • Family environment and abuse

No matter how the triggers develop, until and unless an intervention is provided, this casual use of substances is sure to turn into addiction.

Development of addiction

As the brain and body slowly adjust to the presence of the addictive substance, the feelings of pleasure start to develop with each consumption. As time passes, the body requires more and more of this to sustain this level and produce a higher level of pleasure  (since it builds tolerance).The brain now relies on this to maintain a normal functioning. Since the tolerance becomes higher, the new normal for the brain starts to shift. The balance of the mind and the body is determined by this tolerance. If the person stops using these substances abruptly, this causes symptoms of withdrawal, which suggests that the person has developed addiction.

Social factors are also highly responsible. For example- when a social gathering is conducted, you might feel the urge to indulge in light drinking and enjoyment even when you don’t want to. Here, the factors of peer pressure, belonging and social norms play a huge part.

Ease of access can also fuel this dependence. Without any restraint, the person feels that they can access the substance anytime that results in reckless usage.

Researches on addiction- insights from best psychiatrist in delhi

It is true that addiction is a moral and control failure, but it also comes with the fact that addiction permanently alters the brain structure and chemistry. It takes a significant amount of time to get it back to a functioning stage and pave the way for a functioning neural chemistry. Researchers have found that-

  • Addictive substances destroy key brain survival regions
  • The pleasure and reward systems of the brain are hijacked to want more of the substance. Inducing dependency
  • Emotion and flight- fight response is over stimulated, resulting in anxiety and stress as withdrawal symptoms
  • Severe damage to prefrontal cortex ensues, that results in ineffective decision making
  • There is a genetic component related to addiction, and that is why some people are highly vulnerable to developing addiction while others are not.
  • Teens are highly vulnerable to developing addiction, since their frontal lobes are not fully developed and their impulse control is not matured

Addiction can be a deadly disease, with highly problematic consequences. It is with the right guidance and treatment plans, one can resolve their addiction in no time.

Learn to cease addiction at Tulasi Healthcare

Treatment programs for addiction require a lot of effort and research, and we at Tulasi Health Care have years of experience in the field. Our learning has pointed us to a variety of methods and modalities to get rid of addiction at its core. Some of them are displayed as follows-

  • Medically assisted detoxification
  • Talk therapies like CBT or DBT
  • Holistic therapies like Yoga, Meditation, Mindfulness
  • Group counseling
  • Support groups like Alcoholics Anonymous
  • Individual counseling
  • Aftercare planning

Do you have an addiction?- Seek Help Now

Determining that you or your loved one is suffering from addiction is not as easy as it looks. Acknowledging and taking a step forward is never easy, but developing an insight is necessary.

A yes to any of the below mentioned questions might be your cue to visit an expert like Dr. Gorav Gupta who is a renowned psychiatrist in Delhi, with a specialization in treating addiction disorders.

  • Have you started consuming more substances these days and feel you can’t function without them?
  • Do you feel you are restless and anxious whenever you are unable to consume the substance for longer periods of time?
  • Have you ever denied your condition or lied to others about the use of substance and its effect on your behavior?

It is just not enough to say ‘No’ to the substance. It is essential to take necessary steps to expel it from our lives and seek expert help in case the situation seems out of control. At Tulasi Healthcare, you receive the best care, consultation and management plan from the team of 100+ experts. Understanding the need to putting your well being first, we urge you to make an essential evaluation of your life and visit our rehab center today for an in-depth consultation.

title: Addiction and Rehabilitation- Treating Alcohol Abuse at a rehab centre
h1: Addiction and Rehabilitation- Treating Alcohol Abuse at a rehab centre
excerpt: Alcohol use Disorder is a chronic health condition which affects a person on a physical, psychological, social and emotional plane, rendering them incapable of performing their own task. It includes an extensive use of alcohol which is not restricted to any occasion, time or place. Some signs that indicate alcohol misuse are- Uncontrolled urge to […]
contentHtml:
Alcohol use Disorder is a chronic health condition which affects a person on a physical, psychological, social and emotional plane, rendering them incapable of performing their own task. It includes an extensive use of alcohol which is not restricted to any occasion, time or place. Some signs that indicate alcohol misuse are-

  • Uncontrolled urge to consume alcohol
  • No specific limit over drinking
  • Negative thought patterns while/after/before consuming alcohol
  • Drinking in any situation
  • Considering drinking as the only solution
  • Surrendering all tasks and prioritizing drinking

If any of these pointers apply to you or you suspect your loved one to fit any of these, you should approach a rehab center for an extensive consultation.

Stages of alcohol use

Any habit takes time to convert to misuse. There are 4 stages  which a substance user goes through.

  • At risk- Casual use of alcohol is seen in normal to joyous occasions to ‘lower stress’. At this stage, the body starts getting used to or ‘build tolerance’ towards the alcohol.
  • Early stage- The stage of drinking alone, here the person starts drinking any chance they get and finding an escape in drinking. Till this stage, control is still established.
  • Mild stage- At this stage, the control worsens and the person starts neglecting other important issues for drinking, or drinking to ignore their problems.
  • Severe stage- The person’s social, emotional, physical and psychological conditions shambles and all they care about is drinking. Serious organ damage ensues and comorbid conditions emerge.

Screening- pursuing rehabilitation for alcoholism

The screening process requires some basic medical tests, along with a series of questions that are confirmed with the client themselves or with their family members. Some of these questions are listed here.

  • Have you ever drank more alcohol than you meant to? Has this happened many times?
  • Ever tried to put an end to drinking but could not?
  • Felt a strong urge to drink very frequently?
  • Have you missed out on important days and milestones due to heavy effects of alcohol?
  • Continued to drink even when it caused tension in your family or social circle?
  • Skipped important tasks to drink?
  • Felt withdrawal symptoms like chills, anxiety and restlessness when not under the effect of alcohol?
  • Felt yourselves doing risky things under the spell of alcohol?

If most of the answers point towards an agreement, then the client is facing a serious alcohol abuse issue and they should seek immediate treatment.

Complications and risks

Too much alcohol can cause a lot of damage. The effects are not only physically drastic, but also psychologically and socially. Some common complications and risks are discussed.

  • Liver damage- Since alcohol is a toxin, long term use can cause liver cirrhosis, tissue scarring and fatty liver.
  • Heart disease- High levels of fats and cholesterol rise in the body due to alcohol use and can become a reason for stroke, blood clots and heart attacks.
  • CNS and brain issues- The brain communication pathways are severely affected due to toxin exposure. Nerve cells inside the brain are at risk of damage that may lead to dementia and memory loss.
  • Anemia- Since the body is unable to make enough RBCs to move oxygen around, it causes inflammation and anemia in the blood.
  • Cancer- There is a clear correlation between alcohol and cancer development. Cancer can develop in parts of the liver, intestine and stomach.
  • Seizures- use of alcohol can lead to epilepsy. After a heavy withdrawal, seizures may set in.
  • Gout- A painful buildup of uric acid can cause gout, which happens when consumption of a food compound called purine is high which is found in alcohol.

Approaching a rehab center for intervention

To choose the best approach you want, there is a list of questions you can ask your healthcare providers to make sure they maintain the proper standards of management.

  • Is there insurance available to cover the costs?
  • Is the staff trained and licensed to handle cases of recovery and addiction?
  • Can you provide a proper plan of treatment?
  • Are in house medical and counseling facilities available?
  • Is an after care program available for the clients?

As one of the best rehabilitation center in Delhi, Tulasi Healthcare meets all the standards of care and management strategies to bring the transformation needed for the well being of the client.

Intervention strategies at our rehab center in Delhi

Treatment approaches are usually personalized at Tulasi Healthcare, since we believe in the motto of ‘every client is different in their own way’. Intervention strategies for alcohol abuse are listed below which are usually applied in different combinations for every patient.

  • Medically assisted detoxification
  • Clinical diagnosis and case management
  • Individual therapy sessions (CBT)
  • Psychoeducation
  • Family counseling sessions
  • Group counseling sessions and therapy
  • Support groups (Alcoholics Anonymous) participations
  • Relapse prevention strategies

Inpatient services for severe cases at Tulasi Healthcare

In cases of severe alcohol abuse, it becomes necessary for the client to take treatment as an inpatient, that helps the caregivers keep a keen eye on their recovery and facilitate faster recovery and management plan. A serene and positive environment alleviates their motivation and spirit to induce a faster transformation. The environment creates a positive aura to concentrate better on the holistic aspects of recovery like yoga, meditation and physical activities, which are an essential part of detox.

We create every minute detail at our facility that is essential for facilitating a healthy development of our client’s mindset.

Seek help TODAY

No matter how out of control your situation may seem, it is better to consult a caregiver at the earliest. The treatment can be facilitated as soon as the client shows willingness to proceed towards their well being. At Tulasi healthcare, our team of experienced professionals welcome everyone, regardless of their status quo. Our focus is on providing help to anyone who needs it, and help addiction victims claim control of their lives. If you and your loved ones are facing such issues and relate to the content of this blog, pay a visit at our facility and get an extensive consultation from our experts.

title: New Treatment Approaches to OCD : ERP and dTMS
h1: New Treatment Approaches to OCD : ERP and dTMS

featuredImage.alt: OCD new treatment erp and dtms

excerpt: OCD and it’s new treatment approaches Obsessive Compulsive disorder has grown to be a highly occurring condition in the Indian Population- especially teenagers. contentHtml:
OCD and it's new treatment approaches

Obsessive Compulsive disorder has grown to be a highly occurring condition in the Indian Population- especially teenagers. According to the National Institute of Health, around 0.8% of the young adult population is suffering from OCD. With a lifetime prevalence of 0.6%, OCD needs high-end management strategies for facilitating overall daily functioning and social conduct.

Medications, invasive and therapy sessions are integral part of its management and diagnosis, but there are many cases that are resistant to such treatment and require discovery of other methods that can alleviate their symptoms and restore their well being.

Today, we talk about Exposure and Response prevention and Deep Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation  as some of the new OCD treatment modalities that allows us to explore the disorder in a new light.

In the Indian scenario, usually both inpatient and outpatient treatments are considered. Outpatient treatment is suitable for clients that suffer from mild to moderate conditions, and inpatient is usually prescribed for clients who are facing adverse effects of the condition and unable to restore their daily functioning.

What is Exposure and Response Prevention (ERP)?

Simply put, it is also a derivative of the Cognitive Behavioral Therapy that encourages the client to face their fears, or obsessive thoughts occur, without the thought of putting them right with compulsive behaviors. The strategy is to purposefully expose oneself to situations that might trigger a response and generate  control in its wake. The difference from flooding here is that a clinician works with you in a comprehensive manner to generate a plan for exposure. Then, the therapist coaches you to understand and confront these feelings by acceptance and resisting to lean into compulsive behavior.

The following patterns are initiated once ERP is executed-

  • As a part of the treatment, you may feel an initial increase in anxiety, compulsions, uncertainties and obsessional thoughts.
  • Within a time frame, the client starts to understand that the feelings will arise but they are not capable of harming them in the long run- they can be managed.
  • When the feeling becomes familiar, the resistance towards them will eventually subside, causing habituation.
  • Managing everyday uncertainty and risks will become easier.

OCD takes over the body’s alarm system and reacts to any and every trigger- without justifying its intensity and that causes a rift in everyday functioning. Even the most trivial stimuli are considered catastrophic. This is the reason why the body reacts- or engages in compulsive behavior to subside its concerns.

It can be helpful for people who:

  • Have an extreme fear of contaminating germs or other pathogens capable of harm
  • Have a fear of losing control over oneself and risk of harming others
  • Get intrusive thoughts that have no relation to task at hand and disrupt daily life
  • Have an excessive focus on moral and religious ideals
  • Get an extensive urge to perform a compulsion after an irrational act.

If one feels that they can benefit from approaching an expert for their condition, it is better to reach out today. Amongst some of the good psychiatrist in delhi, we boast a highly trained group of professionals that have training in many new OCD treatment modalities and upgrade themselves every chance they get.

Why is ERP important for treating OCD?

ERP provides a basis for the clients to observe their behavior, analyze their responses and actively work towards them. ERP acts as a key therapeutic component in management of the disorder. If it is combined with SSRIs and therapy it is even more effective. It also works on relapse prevention scenarios and how the client can manage it.

What is Deep TMS?

Another highly coveted treatment modality for OCD is Deep Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation, which is very efficient in alleviating symptoms for clients that are not able to achieve any success in subsiding effects of OCD with traditional medicine.The treatment utilizes a magnetic coil to directly reach broader and deeper brain regions responsible for OCD- specifically Anterior Cingulate Cortex and medial Prefrontal Cortex. Peer reviewed studies claim that 1 in 3 treatment resistant OCD patients achieve higher levels of relief from deep TMS treatment.

As a non-invasive treatment, it does not have any long term side effects, does not have any extensive recovery period and can be accommodated into the daily schedule of the clients.

As an FDA approved treatment plan, it has proved its efficacy to treat OCD through a study published by American Journal of Psychiatry in 2019. When combined with other treatment plans, it shows significant improvement in the symptoms of OCD and a higher recovery rate as well. According to a study published by Journal of psychiatric research, this new OCD treatment has a greater real life application than a clinical setting. This study was conducted on 200 individuals, with nearly 60% showing high level response and sustained  response of over 50% (after a one month follow up).

Its efficacy is highly established with its non-invasive nature and duly incorporative nature in everyday schedule.

Treatment Protocol for deep TMS

The treatment includes a 90 minute preparation session that is designed to know the clients provocative symptoms based on their individual complaints. The care plan is designed for around 6 weeks, where the duration depends upon the severity of the symptoms. There are 5 sessions in each week which takes 30-40 minutes in total for administration (provocation administration + 18 minute TMS protocol). To assess the progress, Y-BOCS is administered at the baseline treatment each week.

Looking for help with your OCD? We can assist you.

Obsessive compulsive disorder that can disrupt your routine and create undesirable conditions of stress and anxiety. When people have OCD, it is important for them to find a professional that can assist them in restoring their quality of life.

With Dr. Gorav Gupta’s unfettered support and expertise, you can achieve a dramatic difference in your condition given his status of being one of the best psychiatrist in Delhi NCR. To know more, visit the OCD treatment in gurgaon facility and discover your own treatment plans customized to your needs.

title: Why is Mental Health Important?
h1: What is Mental Health and It's Importance?
excerpt: What is Mental Health and It’s Importance? According to WHO, mental health is a state of well-being. Mental well-being enables people to cope with the stresses of life, learn and work well, contribute to society as a civilised individual and realise their abilities. Many people use positive mental health and well-being synonymously. Both these terms […]
contentHtml:
According to WHO, mental health is a state of well-being. Mental well-being enables people to cope with the stresses of life, learn and work well, contribute to society as a civilised individual and realise their abilities. Many people use positive mental health and well-being synonymously. Both these terms refer to the same state but are entirely different. Mental health is a fundamental human right and significant for personal, community, and socio-economic development, whereas well-being enables a positive environment for positive mental health.

Mental health is not just the absence of mental disorders. It is a much broader subject, and let’s dive into it.

MENTAL HEALTH AWARENESS:

Awareness regarding any health issue is necessary to eradicate the stigma and discrimination that comes with it. It is also a great way to highlight the consequences of ignorance and misinformation about the same issue. For this same reason and multiple others, Mental Health Awareness Month is celebrated from 1 May to 31 May, where different themes and topics are discussed, and every year, Mental Health Day is also celebrated on 10 October. Mental Health Awareness programs have had favourable impacts and can stimulate positive change in people’s views of mental illnesses.

MENTAL ILLNESSES:

Everyone feels worried or anxious from time to time, but this is not what we call mental illness. A mental illness is a mental health condition that gets in the way of thinking, relating to others and day-to-day functions. Some of the mental illnesses that have been identified and defined are depression, generalised anxiety disorder, bipolar disorder, obsessive-compulsive disorder, post-traumatic stress syndrome, schizophrenia and many more.

WHAT CAUSES THESE ILLNESSES?

There can be many unfavourable social, economic, geographical and environmental circumstances like poverty, violence, and inequality that can increase the risks of people experiencing mental health conditions. Several biological and psychological factors like substance abuse, poor emotional skills and genetics can make people more vulnerable to mental health problems. Not so astonishingly, harsh parenting, physical punishments and bullying are seen as leading causes for mental health issues in young children. But at the end of the day, illnesses are always acquired from person to person. Most people don’t develop a mental health condition despite their exposure to a risk factor, and many people with no risk factor whatsoever still develop mental health conditions.

  • After the COVID-19 pandemic, most mental health disorders arise during adolescence.
  • Worldwide, 13% of people between the ages of 10 and 19 live with a diagnosed mental health disorder, according to UNICEF reports.
  • Anxiety and depression constitute more than 40% of mental health disorders among young people (those aged 10-19).
  • In many countries, suicide is the leading cause of death of young people in that age group.

Sadly, psychological distress, not just among young people but in almost all age groups, seems to be rising.

This calls for multiple mental health-related facilities, institutes and individuals. The need has been recognised, whether it be therapies, psychologists, mental hospitals, or counsellors. Multiple Mental Healthcare facilities and Mental Hospitals in India like Tulasi Healthcare provide treatment for Bipolar, Schizophrenia, Depression, and OCD. In nearby areas, individuals also seek support from a psychologist in Gurgaon for regular medical and mental welfare support.

IMPORTANCE OF MENTAL HEALTH-

A large population of India is now involved in its mental health. The only way forward is through improvement in this field. Maintaining positive mental health is crucial for behaviours, emotions, and thoughts. Focusing on mental health can increase productivity, self-image, self-confidence, and relationships.

The benefits of taking care of our mental health are:

  • Reduces anxiety.
  • Thinking more clearly.
  • Improving our mood.
  • Improving relationships.

Promoting mental health reduces risks, builds resilience and establishes supportive environments. Having a Tough conversation and admitting to problems mean that there can be solutions we can come up with. Initialising these talks can help someone reach out to you when they need help; asking for help is a sign of strength. Visiting facilities is becoming easier, with a rise in the awareness levels. Many mental hospitals in India are taking active steps to curb myths around this field. Talking about all these issues can help raise awareness about lesser-known symptoms.

POSITIVE IMPACT ON MENTAL HEALTH:

  • Seeking therapy.
  • Journaling for mental health.
  • Practicing mindfulness
  • Exercise
  • Yoga

NEGATIVE IMPACTS ON MENTAL HEALTH:

  • Past trauma
  • Long term stress
  • Loneliness
  • Discrimination
  • Unemployment
  • Long-term physical conditions
  • Relationship struggles
  • Broken family dynamics.

WHO has provided meaningful progress towards better mental health for populations around the globe by focusing on three “paths of transformation.”

  • To deepen the value given to mental health by individuals, communities and governments.
  • Reshape environments’ physical, social, and economic characteristics- in homes, schools, workplaces, and broader communities- to better protect and prevent mental health conditions.
  • Strengthen mental health care so that the full spectrum of mental health needs is met through a community-based network of accessible, affordable and quality service supports.

Along with WHO and UNICEF reports, studies show the transformational part and why researchers and communities must work together and study mental health and well-being. Learning more about mental health allows us to provide helpful support to those affected in our families and communities. Promoting child and adolescent mental health is another priority and can be achieved by policies and laws that encourage and protect cognitive health.

Suicide prevention is a global priority and included in the Sustainable Development Goals 2030. Many changes can be made in this social construct by responsible media reporting, social and emotional learning for adolescents, and early interventions.

Many visit multiple health facilities and health care providers like psychiatrists in delhi  and therapists for more frequent counselling sessions. A variety of treatment options exist for different mental health issues. Factors like proper diet, sleep and exercise can positively impact our mental health. Lack of sleep, poor diet and lack of exercise can decelerate our ability to manage stress and life’s demands.

Seeking Help with Tulasi Healthcare

“When in a state of good mental health, a person has a generally positive outlook and can accomplish tasks, maintain relationships and engage in meaningful recreation,” said Dr. Darleen Dempster. If you are a person who is dealing with mental health issues, there is no better time than right now to ask for help. Never hesitate to prioritise your physical and mental health before anything else. Your mental health is just as important as your physical health that completes the puzzle of your life.
